verses.am: የሮቤልም ሰፈር ዓላማ በየሠራዊታቸው ተጓዘ፤ በሠራዊቱም ላይ የሰዲዮር ልጅ ኤሊሱር አለቃ ነበረ።

verses.en: And over the host of the tribe of the children of Simeon was Shelumiel the son of Zurishaddai.
verses.am: በስምዖንም ልጆች ነገድ ሠራዊት ላይ የሱሪሰዳይ ልጅ ሰለሚኤል አለቃ ነበረ።

verses.en: And over the host of the tribe of the children of Gad was Eliasaph the son of Deuel.
verses.am: በጋድም ልጆች ነገድ ሠራዊት ላይ የራጉኤል ልጅ ኤሊሳፍ አለቃ ነበረ።

verses.en: And the Kohathites set forward, bearing the sanctuary: and the other did set up the tabernacle against they came.
verses.am: ቀዓታውያንም መቅደሱን ተሸክመው ተጓዙ፤ እነዚህም እስኪመጡ ድረስ እነዚያ ማደሪያውን ተከሉ።

verses.en: And the standard of the camp of the children of Ephraim set forward according to their armies: and over his host was Elishama the son of Ammihud.
verses.am: የኤፍሬምም ልጆች ሰፈር ዓላማ በየሠራዊታቸው ተጓዘ፤ በሠራዊቱም ላይ የዓሚሁድ ልጅ ኤሊሳማ አለቃ ነበረ።

verses.en: And over the host of the tribe of the children of Manasseh was Gamaliel the son of Pedahzur.
verses.am: በምናሴም ልጆች ነገድ ሠራዊት ላይ የፍዳሱር ልጅ ገማልኤል አለቃ ነበረ።

verses.en: And over the host of the tribe of the children of Benjamin was Abidan the son of Gideoni.
verses.am: በብንያምም ልጆች ነገድ ሠራዊት ላይ የጋዴዮን ልጅ አቢዳን አለቃ ነበረ።

verses.en: And the standard of the camp of the children of Dan set forward, which was the rereward of all the camps throughout their hosts: and over his host was Ahiezer the son of Ammishaddai.
verses.am: ከሰፈሮቹ ሁሉ በኋላ የሆነ የዳን ልጆች ሰፈር ዓላማ በየሠራዊታቸው ተጓዘ፤ በሠራዊቱም ላይ የአሚሳዳይ ልጅ አኪዔዘር አለቃ ነበረ።

verses.en: And over the host of the tribe of the children of Asher was Pagiel the son of Ocran.
verses.am: በአሴርም ልጆች ነገድ ሠራዊት ላይ የኤክራን ልጅ ፋግኤል አለቃ ነበረ።

verses.en: And over the host of the tribe of the children of Naphtali was Ahira the son of Enan.
verses.am: በንፍታሌምም ልጆች ነገድ ሠራዊት ላይ የዔናን ልጅ አኪሬ አለቃ ነበረ።

verses.en: Thus were the journeyings of the children of Yisra'el according to their armies, when they set forward.
verses.am: እንዲሁ የእስራኤል ልጆች ጕዞ በየሠራዊታቸው ነበረ፤ እነርሱም ተጓዙ።

verses.en: And Mosheh said unto Hobab, the son of Raguel the Midianite, Mosheh' father in law, We are journeying unto the place of which YAHUAH said, I will give it you: come thou with us, and we will do thee good: for YAHUAH hath spoken good concerning Yisra'el.
verses.am: ሙሴም የሚስቱን አባት የምድያማዊውን የራጉኤልን ልጅ ኦባብን። እግዚአብሔር። ለእናንተ እሰጠዋለሁ ወዳለው ስፍራ እንሄዳለን፤ እግዚአብሔር ስለ እስራኤል መልካምን ነገር ተናግሮአልና አንተ ከእኛ ጋር ና፥ መልካምን እናደርግልሃለን አለው።

verses.en: And he said unto him, I will not go; but I will depart to mine own land, and to my kindred.
verses.am: እርሱም። አልሄድም፥ ነገር ግን ወደ አገሬና ወደ ዘመዶቼ እሄዳለሁ አለው።

verses.en: And he said, Leave us not, I pray thee; forasmuch as thou knowest how we are to encamp in the wilderness, and thou mayest be to us instead of eyes.
verses.am: እርሱም። እባክህ፥ በምድረ በዳ የምንሰፍርበትን አንተ ታውቃለህና፥ እንደ ዓይኖቻችንም ትሆንልናለህና አትተወን፤

verses.en: And it shall be, if thou go with us, yea, it shall be, that what goodness YAHUAH shall do unto us, the same will we do unto thee.
verses.am: ከእኛም ጋር ብትሄድ እግዚአብሔር ከሚያደርግልን መልካም ነገር ሁሉ እኛ ለአንተ እናደርጋለን አለ።

verses.en: And they departed from the mount of YAHUAH three days' journey: and the ark of the covenant of YAHUAH went before them in the three days' journey, to search out a resting place for them.
verses.am: ከእግዚአብሔርም ተራራ የሦስት ቀን መንገድ ያህል ተጓዙ፤ የእግዚአብሔርም የኪዳኑ ታቦት የሚያድርበትን ስፍራ ይፈልግላቸው ዘንድ የሦስት ቀን መንገድ ቀደማቸው።

verses.en: And the cloud of YAHUAH was upon them by day, when they went out of the camp.
verses.am: ከሰፈራቸውም በተጓዙ ጊዜ የእግዚአብሔር ደመና ቀን ቀን በላያቸው ነበረ።

verses.en: And it came to pass, when the ark set forward, that Mosheh said, Rise up, YAHUAH, and let thine enemies be scattered; and let them that hate thee flee before thee.
verses.am: ሙሴም ታቦቱ በተጓዘ ጊዜ። አቤቱ፥ ተነሣ፥ ጠላቶችህም ይበተኑ፥ የሚጠሉህም ከፊትህ ይሽሹ ይል ነበር።

verses.en: And when it rested, he said, Return, O YAHUAH, unto the many thousands of Yisra'el.
verses.am: ባረፈም ጊዜ። አቤቱ፥ ወደ እስራኤል እልፍ አእላፋት ተመለስ ይል ነበር።

verses.en: And when the people complained, it displeased YAHUAH: and YAHUAH heard it; and his anger was kindled; and the fire of YAHUAH burnt among them, and consumed them that were in the uttermost parts of the camp.
verses.am: ሕዝቡም ክፉ ሆነው በእግዚአብሔር ላይ አጕረመረሙ፤ እግዚአብሔርም ሰምቶ ተቈጣ፤ የእግዚአብሔርም እሳት በመካከላቸው ነደደች፥ የሰፈሩንም ዳር በላች።

verses.en: And the people cried unto Mosheh; and when Mosheh prayed unto YAHUAH, the fire was quenched.
verses.am: ሕዝቡም ወደ ሙሴ ጮኹ፤ ሙሴም ወደ እግዚአብሔር ጸለየ፥ እሳቲቱም ጠፋች።

verses.en: And he called the name of the place Taberah: because the fire of YAHUAH burnt among them.
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔርም እሳት በመካከላቸው ስለነደደች የዚያን ስፍራ ስም ተቤራ ብሎ ጠራው።

verses.en: And the mixt multitude that was among them fell a lusting: and the children of Yisra'el also wept again, and said, Who shall give us flesh to eat?
verses.am: በመካከላቸውም የነበሩ ልዩ ልዩ ሕዝብ እጅግ ጐመጁ፤ የእስራኤል ልጆች ደግሞ ያለቅሱ ነበር። የምንበላውን ሥጋ ማን ይሰጠናል?

verses.en: We remember the fish, which we did eat in Mitsrayim freely; the cucumbers, and the melons, and the leeks, and the onions, and the garlick:
verses.am: በግብፅ ያለ ዋጋ እንበላው የነበረውን ዓሣ፥ ዱባውንም፥ በጢኹንም፥ ኩራቱንም፥ ቀዩንም ሽንኩርት፥ ነጩንም ሽንኩርት እናስባለን፤

verses.en: But now our soul is dried away: there is nothing at all, beside this manna, before our eyes.
verses.am: አሁን ግን ሰውነታችን ደረቀች፤ ዓይናችንም ከዚህ መና በቀር ምንም አታይም አሉ።

verses.en: And the manna was as coriander seed, and the colour thereof as the colour of bdellium.
verses.am: መናውም እንደ ድንብላል ዘር ነበረ፥ መልኩም ሙጫ ይመስል ነበር።

verses.en: And the people went about, and gathered it, and ground it in mills, or beat it in a mortar, and baked it in pans, and made cakes of it: and the taste of it was as the taste of fresh oil.
verses.am: ሕዝቡም እየዞሩ ይለቅሙ ነበር፥ በወፍጮም ይፈጩት፥ ወይም በሙቀጫ ይወቅጡት፥ በምንቸትም ይቀቅሉት ነበር፥ እንጐቻም ያደርጉት ነበር፤ ጣዕሙም በዘይት እንደ ተለወሰ እንጐቻ ነበረ።

verses.en: And when the dew fell upon the camp in the night, the manna fell upon it.
verses.am: ሌሊትም ጠል በሰፈሩ ላይ በወረደ ጊዜ መናው በላዩ ይወርድ ነበር።

verses.en: Then Mosheh heard the people weep throughout their families, every man in the door of his tent: and the anger of YAHUAH was kindled greatly; Mosheh also was displeased.
verses.am: ሙሴም ሕዝቡ በወገኖቻቸው፥ ሰው ሁሉ በድንኳኑ ደጃፍ፥ ሲያለቅሱ ሰማ፤ የእግዚአብሔርም ቍጣ እጅግ ነደደ፤ ሙሴም ተቈጣ።

verses.en: And Mosheh said unto YAHUAH, Wherefore hast thou afflicted thy servant? and wherefore have I not found favour in thy sight, that thou layest the burden of all this people upon me?
verses.am: ሙሴም እግዚአብሔርን አለው። ለምን በባሪያህ ላይ ክፉ አደረግህ? ለምንስ በፊትህ ሞገስ አላገኘሁም? ለምንስ የዚህን ሕዝብ ሁሉ ሸክም በእኔ ላይ አደረግህ?

verses.en: Have I conceived all this people? have I begotten them, that thou shouldest say unto me, Carry them in thy bosom, as a nursing father beareth the sucking child, unto the land which thou swarest unto their fathers?
verses.am: አንተ ለአባቶቻቸው ወደ ማልህላቸው ምድር አደርሳቸው ዘንድ። ሞግዚት የሚጠባውን ልጅ እንድታቀፍ በብብትህ እቀፋቸው የምትለኝ፥ በውኑ ይህን ሕዝብ ሁሉ እኔ ፀነስሁትን? ወለድሁትንስ?

verses.en: Whence should I have flesh to give unto all this people? for they weep unto me, saying, Give us flesh, that we may eat.
verses.am: በፊቴ ያለቅሳሉና። የምንበላውን ሥጋ ስጠን ይላሉና ለዚህ ሕዝብ ሁሉ የምሰጠው ሥጋ ከወዴት እወስዳለሁ?

verses.en: I am not able to bear all this people alone, because it is too heavy for me.
verses.am: እጅግ ከብዶኛልና ይህን ሁሉ ሕዝብ ልሸከም አልችልም።

verses.en: And if thou deal thus with me, kill me, I pray thee, out of hand, if I have found favour in thy sight; and let me not see my wretchedness.
verses.am: እንዲህስ ከምታደርግብኝ፥ በፊትህ ሞገስ አግኝቼ እንደ ሆነ፥ በእኔ ላይ የሚሆነውን መከራ እንዳላይ፥ እባክህ፥ ፈጽሞ ግደለኝ።

verses.en: And YAHUAH said unto Mosheh, Gather unto me seventy men of the elders of Yisra'el, whom thou knowest to be the elders of the people, and officers over them; and bring them unto the tabernacle of the congregation, that they may stand there with thee.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን አለው። ከእስራኤል ሽማግሌዎች፥ በሕዝቡ ላይ ሽማግሌዎችና አለቆች ይሆኑ ዘንድ የምታውቃቸውን፥ ሰባ ሰዎች ሰብስብልኝ፥ ወደ መገናኛውም ድንኳን አምጣቸው፥ በዚያም ከአንተ ጋር አቁማቸው።

verses.en: And I will come down and talk with thee there: and I will take of the spirit which is upon thee, and will put it upon them; and they shall bear the burden of the people with thee, that thou bear it not thyself alone.
verses.am: እኔም እወርዳለሁ፥ በዚያም እነጋገርሃለሁ፥ በአንተ ካለውም መንፈስ ወስጄ በእነርሱ ላይ አደርገዋለሁ፤ አንተም ብቻ እንዳትሸከም የሕዝቡን ሸክም ከአንተ ጋር ይሸከማሉ።

verses.en: And say thou unto the people, Sanctify yourselves against to morrow, and ye shall eat flesh: for ye have wept in the ears of YAHUAH, saying, Who shall give us flesh to eat? for it was well with us in Mitsrayim: therefore YAHUAH will give you flesh, and ye shall eat.
verses.am: ሕዝቡንም በላቸው። የምንበላውን ሥጋ ማን ይሰጠናል? በግብፅ ደኅና ነበረልን እያላችሁ ያለቀሳችሁት ወደ እግዚአብሔር ጆሮ ደርሶአልና ለነገ ተቀደሱ፥ ሥጋንም ትበላላችሁ፤ እግዚአብሔርም ሥጋን ይሰጣችኋል፥ ትበሉማላችሁ።

verses.en: Ye shall not eat one day, nor two days, nor five days, neither ten days, nor twenty days;
verses.am: አንድ ቀን ወይም ሁለት ቀን ወይም አምስት ቀን ወይም አሥር ቀን ወይም ሀያ ቀን አትበሉም፤

verses.en: But even a whole month, until it come out at your nostrils, and it be loathsome unto you: because that ye have despised YAHUAH which is among you, and have wept before him, saying, Why came we forth out of Mitsrayim?
verses.am: ነገር ግን በመካከላችሁ ያለውን እግዚአብሔርን ንቃችኋልና፥ በፊቱም። ለምን ከግብፅ ወጣን? ብላችሁ አልቅሳችኋልና በአፍንጫችሁ እስኪወጣ እስኪሰለቻችሁም ድረስ ወር ሙሉ ትበሉታላችሁ።

verses.en: And Mosheh said, The people, among whom I am, are six hundred thousand footmen; and thou hast said, I will give them flesh, that they may eat a whole month.
verses.am: ሙሴም። እኔ በመካከላቸው ያለሁ ሕዝብ ስድስት መቶ ሺህ እግረኛ ናቸው፤ አንተም። ወር ሙሉ የሚበሉትን ሥጋ እኔ እሰጣቸዋለሁ አልህ።

verses.en: Shall the flocks and the herds be slain for them, to suffice them? or shall all the fish of the sea be gathered together for them, to suffice them?
verses.am: እነርሱን የሚያጠግብ የበሬና የበግ መንጋ ይታረድን? ወይስ የባሕርን ዓሣ ሁሉ ያጠግባቸው ዘንድ ይሰበሰብላቸዋልን? አለ።

verses.en: And YAHUAH said unto Mosheh, Is YAHUAH's hand waxed short? thou shalt see now whether my word shall come to pass unto thee or not.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን። በውኑ የእግዚአብሔር እጅ አጭር ሆነ? አሁን ቃሌ ይፈጸም ወይስ አይፈጸም እንደ ሆነ አንተ ታያለህ አለው።

verses.en: And Mosheh went out, and told the people the words of YAHUAH, and gathered the seventy men of the elders of the people, and set them round about the tabernacle.
verses.am: ሙሴም ወጣ የእግዚአብሔርንም ቃሎች ለሕዝቡ ነገረ፤ ከሕዝቡ ሽማግሌዎችም ሰባውን ሰዎች ሰብስቦ በድንኳኑ ዙሪያ አቆማቸው።

verses.en: And YAHUAH came down in a cloud, and spake unto him, and took of the spirit that was upon him, and gave it unto the seventy elders: and it came to pass, that, when the spirit rested upon them, they prophesied, and did not cease.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር በደመናው ወረደ፥ ተናገረውም፥ በእርሱም ላይ ከነበረው መንፈስ ወስዶ በሰባው ሽማግሌዎች ላይ አደረገ፤ መንፈሱም በላያቸው ባደረ ጊዜ ትንቢት ተናገሩ፤ ከዚያ በኋል ግን አልተናገሩም።

verses.en: But there remained two of the men in the camp, the name of the one was Eldad, and the name of the other Medad: and the spirit rested upon them; and they were of them that were written, but went not out unto the tabernacle: and they prophesied in the camp.
verses.am: ከእነርሱም ሁለት ሰዎች በሰፈር ቀርተው ነበር፥ የአንዱም ስም ኤልዳድ የሁለተኛውም ሞዳድ ነበረ፤ መንፈስም ወረደባቸው፤ እነርሱም ከተጻፉት ጋር ነበሩ ወደ ድንኳኑ ግን አልወጡም ነበር፤ በሰፈሩም ውስጥ ሳሉ ትንቢት ተናገሩ።

verses.en: And there ran a young man, and told Mosheh, and said, Eldad and Medad do prophesy in the camp.
verses.am: አንድ ጐበዝ ሰው እየሮጠ መጥቶ። ኤልዳድና ሞዳድ በሰፈር ትንቢት ይናገራሉ ብሎ ለሙሴ ነገረው።

verses.en: And Yahoshua the son of Nun, the servant of Mosheh, one of his young men, answered and said, My lord Mosheh, forbid them.
verses.am: ከልጅነቱ ጀምሮ የሙሴ አገልጋይ የነበረው የነዌ ልጅ ኢያሱ። ጌታዬ ሙሴ ሆይ፥ ከልክላቸው አለው።

verses.en: And Mosheh said unto him, Enviest thou for my sake? would YAHUAH that all YAHUAH's people were prophets, and that YAHUAH would put his spirit upon them!
verses.am: ሙሴም። የእግዚአብሔር ሕዝብ ሁሉ ነቢያት ቢሆኑ፥ እግዚአብሔርም በእነርሱ ላይ መንፈሱን ቢያወርድ፤ አንተ ስለእኔ ትቀናለህን? አለው።

verses.en: And Mosheh gat him into the camp, he and the elders of Yisra'el.
verses.am: ሙሴም ከእስራኤል ሽማግሌዎች ጋር ወደ ሰፈር ተመለሰ።

verses.en: And there went forth a wind from YAHUAH, and brought quails from the sea, and let them fall by the camp, as it were a day's journey on this side, and as it were a day's journey on the other side, round about the camp, and as it were two cubits high upon the face of the earth.
verses.am: ነፋስም ከእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ ወጣ፥ ከባሕርም ድርጭቶችን አመጣ፥ የአንድ ቀንም መንገድ ያህል በዚህ፥ የአንድ ቀንም መንገድ ያህል በዚያ በሰፈሩ ላይ በተናቸው፤ በዚያም በሰፈሩ ዙሪያ ከፍታው ከምድር ወደ ላይ ሁለት ክንድ ነበረ።

verses.en: And the people stood up all that day, and all that night, and all the next day, and they gathered the quails: he that gathered least gathered ten homers: and they spread them all abroad for themselves round about the camp.
verses.am: በዚያም ቀን ሁሉ በሌሊትም ሁሉ በነጋውም ሁሉ ሕዝቡ ተነሥተው ድርጭትን ሰበሰቡ፤ ከሁሉ ጥቂት የሰበሰበ አሥር የቆሮስ መስፈሪያ የሚያህል ሰበሰበ፤ በሰፈሩም ዙሪያ ሁሉ አሰጡት።

verses.en: And while the flesh was yet between their teeth, ere it was chewed, the wrath of YAHUAH was kindled against the people, and YAHUAH smote the people with a very great plague.
verses.am: ሥጋውም ገና በጥርሳቸው መካከል ሳለ ሳያኝኩትም፥ የእግዚአብሔር ቍጣ በሕዝቡ ላይ ነደደ፤ እግዚአብሔርም ሕዝቡን በታላቅ መቅሠፍት እጅግ መታ።

verses.en: And he called the name of that place Kibrothhattaavah: because there they buried the people that lusted.
verses.am: የጐመጁ ሕዝብ በዚያ ተቀብረዋልና የዚያ ስፍራ ስም የምኞት መቃብር ተብሎ ተጠራ።

verses.en: And the people journeyed from Kibrothhattaavah unto Hazeroth; and abode at Hazeroth.
verses.am: ሕዝቡም ከምኞት መቃብር ወደ ሐጼሮት ተጓዙ በሐጼሮትም ተቀመጡ።

verses.en: And Miriam and Aaron spake against Mosheh because of the Ethiopian woman whom he had married: for he had married an Ethiopian woman.
verses.am: ሙሴም ኢትዮጵያይቱን አግብቶአልና ባገባት በኢትዮጵያይቱ ምክንያት ማርያምና አሮን በእርሱ ላይ ተናገሩ።

verses.en: And they said, Hath YAHUAH indeed spoken only by Mosheh? hath he not spoken also by us? And YAHUAH heard it.
verses.am: እነርሱም። በውኑ እግዚአብሔር በሙሴ ብቻ ተናግሮአልን? በእኛስ ደግሞ የተናገረ አይደለምን? አሉ፤ እግዚአብሔርም ሰማ።

verses.en: (Now the man Mosheh was very meek, above all the men which were upon the face of the earth.)
verses.am: ሙሴም በምድር ላይ ካሉት ሰዎች ሁሉ ይልቅ እጅግ ትሑት ሰው ነበረ።

verses.en: And YAHUAH spake suddenly unto Mosheh, and unto Aaron, and unto Miriam, Come out ye three unto the tabernacle of the congregation. And they three came out.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ወዲያው ሙሴንና አሮንን ማርያምንም። ሦስታችሁ ወደ መገኛኛው ድንኳን ውጡ ብሎ ተናገረ፤ ሦስቱም ወጡ።

verses.en: And YAHUAH came down in the pillar of the cloud, and stood in the door of the tabernacle, and called Aaron and Miriam: and they both came forth.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም በደመና ዓምድ ወረደ፥ በድንኳኑም ደጃፍ ቆመ፤ አሮንንና ማርያምን ጠራ፥ ሁለቱም ወጡ።

verses.en: And he said, Hear now my words: If there be a prophet among you, I YAHUAH will make myself known unto him in a vision, and will speak unto him in a dream.
verses.am: እርሱም። ቃሌን ስሙ፤ በመካከላችሁ ነቢይ ቢኖር፥ እኔ እግዚአብሔር በራእይ እገለጥለታለሁ፥ ወይም በሕልም እናገረዋለሁ።

verses.en: My servant Mosheh is not so, who is faithful in all mine house.
verses.am: ባሪያዬ ሙሴ ግን እንዲህ አይደለም፤ እርሱ በቤቴ ሁሉ የታመነ ነው።

verses.en: With him will I speak mouth to mouth, even apparently, and not in dark speeches; and the similitude of YAHUAH shall he behold: wherefore then were ye not afraid to speak against my servant Mosheh?
verses.am: እኔ አፍ ለአፍ በግልጥ እናገረዋለሁ፥ በምሳሌ አይደለም፤ የእግዚአብሔርንም መልክ ያያል፤ በባሪያዬ በሙሴ ላይ ትናገሩ ዘንድ ስለ ምን አልፈራችሁም? አለ።

verses.en: And the anger of YAHUAH was kindled against them; and he departed.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ተቈጥቶባቸው ሄደ።

verses.en: And the cloud departed from off the tabernacle; and, behold, Miriam became leprous, white as snow: and Aaron looked upon Miriam, and, behold, she was leprous.
verses.am: ደመናውም ከድንኳኑ ተነሣ፤ እነሆም፥ ማርያም ለምጻም ሆነች፥ እንደ አመዳይም ነጭ ሆነች፤ አሮንም ማርያምን ተመለከተ፥ እነሆም፥ ለምጻም ሆና ነበር።

verses.en: And Aaron said unto Mosheh, Alas, my lord, I beseech thee, lay not the sin upon us, wherein we have done foolishly, and wherein we have sinned.
verses.am: አሮንም ሙሴን። ጌታዬ ሆይ፥ ስንፍና አድርገናልና፥ በድለንማልና እባክህ፥ ኃጢአት አታድርግብን።

verses.en: Let her not be as one dead, of whom the flesh is half consumed when he cometh out of his mother's womb.
verses.am: ከእናቱ ሆድ በወጣ ጊዜ ግማሽ ሥጋው ተበልቶ እንደ ሞተ እርስዋ አትሁን።

verses.en: And Mosheh cried unto YAHUAH, saying, Heal her now, O YAHUAH, I beseech thee.
verses.am: ሙሴም ወደ እግዚአብሔር እየጮኸ። አቤቱ፥ እባክህ፥ አድናት አለው።

verses.en: And YAHUAH said unto Mosheh, If her father had but spit in her face, should she not be ashamed seven days? let her be shut out from the camp seven days, and after that let her be received in again.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን። አባትዋ ምራቁን በፊትዋ ቢተፋባት ስንኳ ሰባት ቀን ታፍር ዘንድ ይገባት ነበር፤ ሰባት ቀን ከሰፈር ውጭ ተዘግታ ትቀመጥ፥ ከዚያም በኋላ ትመለስ አለው።

verses.en: And Miriam was shut out from the camp seven days: and the people journeyed not till Miriam was brought in again.
verses.am: ማርያምም ከሰፈር ውጭ ሰባት ቀን ተዘግታ ተቀመጠች፤ ማርያምም እስክትመለስ ድረስ ሕዝቡ አልተጓዙም።

verses.en: And afterward the people removed from Hazeroth, and pitched in the wilderness of Paran.
verses.am: ከዚያም በኋላ ሕዝቡ ከሐጼሮት ተጓዙ፥ በፋራንም ምድረ በዳ ሰፈሩ።

verses.en: And YAHUAH spake unto Mosheh, saying,
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን እንዲህ ብሎ ተናገረው።

verses.en: Send thou men, that they may search the land of Canaan, which I give unto the children of Yisra'el: of every tribe of their fathers shall ye send a man, every one a ruler among them.
verses.am: ለእስራኤል ልጆች የምሰጣትን የከንዓንን ምድር ይሰልሉ ዘንድ ሰዎችን ላክ፤ ከአባቶች ነገድ ሁሉ እያንዳንዱ በመካከላቸው አለቃ የሆነ አንድ ሰው ትልካላችሁ።

verses.en: And Mosheh by the commandment of YAHUAH sent them from the wilderness of Paran: all those men were heads of the children of Yisra'el.
verses.am: ሙሴም እንደ እግዚአብሔር ትእዛዝ ከፋራን ምድረ በዳ ላካቸው፤ እነርሱም ሁሉ የእስራኤል ልጆች አለቆች ነበሩ።

verses.en: And these were their names: of the tribe of Reuben, Shammua the son of Zaccur.
verses.am: ስማቸውም ይህ ነበረ፤ ከሮቤል ነገድ የዘኩር ልጅ ሰሙኤል፤

verses.en: Of the tribe of Simeon, Shaphat the son of Hori.
verses.am: ከስምዖን ነገድ የሱሬ ልጅ ሰፈጥ፤

verses.en: Of the tribe of Yehudah, Caleb the son of Jephunneh.
verses.am: ከይሁዳ ነገድ የዮፎኒ ልጅ ካሌብ፤

verses.en: Of the tribe of Issachar, Igal the son of Yoseph.
verses.am: ከይሳኮር ነገድ የዮሴፍ ልጅ ይግአል፤

verses.en: Of the tribe of Ephraim, Oshea the son of Nun.
verses.am: ከኤፍሬም ነገድ የነዌ ልጅ አውሴ፤

verses.en: Of the tribe of Benjamin, Palti the son of Raphu.
verses.am: ከዮሴፍ ነገድ እርሱም የምናሴ ነገድ የሱሲ ልጅ ጋዲ፤

verses.en: Of the tribe of Zebulun, Gaddiel the son of Sodi.
verses.am: ከዮሴፍ ነገድ እርሱም የምናሴ ነገድ የሱሲ ልጅ ጋዲ፤

verses.en: Of the tribe of Yoseph, namely, of the tribe of Manasseh, Gaddi the son of Susi.
verses.am: ከዳን ነገድ የገማሊ ልጅ ዓሚኤል፤

verses.en: Of the tribe of Dan, Ammiel the son of Gemalli.
verses.am: ከአሴር ነገድ የሚካኤል ልጅ ሰቱር፤

verses.en: Of the tribe of Asher, Sethur the son of Michael.
verses.am: ከንፍታሌም ነገድ የያቢ ልጅ ናቢ፤

verses.en: Of the tribe of Naphtali, Nahbi the son of Vophsi.
verses.am: ከጋድ ነገድ የማኪ ልጅ ጉዲኤል።

verses.en: Of the tribe of Gad, Geuel the son of Machi.
verses.am: ምድሪቱን ይሰልሉ ዘንድ ሙሴ የላካቸው ሰዎች ስም ይህ ነው። ሙሴም የነዌን ልጅ አውሴን ኢያሱ ብሎ ጠራው።

verses.en: These are the names of the men which Mosheh sent to spy out the land. And Mosheh called Oshea the son of Nun Jehoshua.
verses.am: ሙሴም የከነዓንን ምድር ይሰልሉ ዘንድ ላካቸው፥ አላቸውም። ከዚህ በደቡብ በኩል ውጡ፥ ወደ ተራሮችም ሂዱ፤

verses.en: And Mosheh sent them to spy out the land of Canaan, and said unto them, Get you up this way southward, and go up into the mountain:
verses.am: ምድሪቱንም እንዴት እንደ ሆነች፥ በእርስዋም የሚኖሩ ሰዎች ብርቱዎች ወይም ደካሞች፥

verses.en: And see the land, what it is; and the people that dwelleth therein, whether they be strong or weak, few or many;
verses.am: ጥቂቶች ወይም ብዙዎች እንደ ሆኑ፥ የሚኖሩባትም ምድር መልካም ወይም ክፉ፥ የሚኖሩባቸውም ከተሞች ሰፈሮች ወይም አምቦች እንደ ሆኑ፥

verses.en: And what the land is that they dwell in, whether it be good or bad; and what cities they be that they dwell in, whether in tents, or in strong holds;
verses.am: ምድሪቱም ወፍራም ወይም ስስ ዛፍ ያለባት ወይም የሌለባት እንደ ሆነች እዩ፤ ከምድሪቱ ፍሬ አምጡ፤ አይዞአችሁ። በዚያን ጊዜም ወይኑ አስቀድሞ ፍሬ የሚያፈራበት ወራት ነበረ።

verses.en: And what the land is, whether it be fat or lean, whether there be wood therein, or not. And be ye of good courage, and bring of the fruit of the land. Now the time was the time of the firstripe grapes.
verses.am: ወጡም ምድሪቱንም ከጺን ምድረ በዳ በሐማት ዳር እስካለችው እስከ ረአብ ድረስ ሰለሉ።

verses.en: So they went up, and searched the land from the wilderness of Zin unto Rehob, as men come to Hamath.
verses.am: በደቡብም በኩል ውጡ፥ ወደ ኬብሮንም ደረሱ፤ በዚያም የዔናቅ ልጆች አኪመን፥ ሴሲ፥ ተላሚ ነበሩ። ኬብሮንም በግብፅ ካለችው ከጣኔዎስ በፊት ሰባት ዓመት ተሠርታ ነበር።

verses.en: And they ascended by the south, and came unto Hebron; where Ahiman, Sheshai, and Talmai, the children of Anak, were. (Now Hebron was built seven years before Zoan in Mitsrayim.)
verses.am: ወደ ኤሽኮልም ሸለቆ መጡ፥ ከዚያም ከወይኑ አንድ ዘለላ የነበረበትን አረግ ቈረጡ፥ ሁለቱም ሰዎች በመሎጊያ ተሸከሙት፤ ደግሞም ከሮማኑ ከበለሱም አመጡ።

verses.en: And they came unto the brook of Eshcol, and cut down from thence a branch with one cluster of grapes, and they bare it between two upon a staff; and they brought of the pomegranates, and of the figs.
verses.am: የእስራኤል ልጆች ከዚያ ስለ ቈረጡት ዘለላ የዚያን ስፍራ ስም የኤሽኮል ሸለቆ ብለው ጠሩት።

verses.en: The place was called the brook Eshcol, because of the cluster of grapes which the children of Yisra'el cut down from thence.
verses.am: ምድሪቱንም ሰልለው ከአርባ ቀን በኋላ ተመለሱ።

verses.en: And they returned from searching of the land after forty days.
verses.am: በፋራን ምድረ በዳና በቃዴስ ወዳሉት ወደ ሙሴና ወደ አሮን ወደ እስራኤልም ልጆች ማኅበር ሁሉ ሄደው ደረሱ፤ ወሬውንም ለእነርሱና ለማኅበሩ ሁሉ ነገሩአቸው፥ የምድሪቱንም ፍሬ አሳዩአቸው።

verses.en: And they went and came to Mosheh, and to Aaron, and to all the congregation of the children of Yisra'el, unto the wilderness of Paran, to Kadesh; and brought back word unto them, and unto all the congregation, and shewed them the fruit of the land.
verses.am: እንዲህም ብለው ነገሩት። ወደ ላክኸን ምድር ደረስን፥ እርስዋም ወተትና ማር ታፈስሳለች፥ ፍሬዋም ይህ ነው።

verses.en: And they told him, and said, We came unto the land whither thou sentest us, and surely it floweth with milk and honey; and this is the fruit of it.
verses.am: ነገር ግን በምድሪቱ የሚኖሩ ሰዎች ኃያላን ናቸው። ከተሞቻቸውም የተመሸጉ እጅግም የጸኑ ናቸው፤ ደግሞም በዚያ የዔናቅን ልጆች አየን።

verses.en: Nevertheless the people be strong that dwell in the land, and the cities are walled, and very great: and moreover we saw the children of Anak there.
verses.am: በደቡብም ምድር አማሌቅ ተቀምጦአል፤ በተራሮቹም ኬጢያዊና ኢያቡሳዊ አሞራዊም ተቀምጠዋል፤ ከነዓናዊም በባሕር ዳርና በዮርዳኖስ አጠገብ ተቀምጦአል።

verses.en: The Amalekites dwell in the land of the south: and the Hittites, and the Jebusites, and the Amorites, dwell in the mountains: and the Canaanites dwell by the sea, and by the coast of Jordan.
verses.am: ካሌብም ሕዝቡን በሙሴ ፊት ዝም አሰኘና። ማሸነፍ እንችላለንንና እንውጣ፥ እንውረሰው አለ።

verses.en: And Caleb stilled the people before Mosheh, and said, Let us go up at once, and possess it; for we are well able to overcome it.
verses.am: ከእርሱ ጋር የወጡ ሰዎች ግን። በኃይል ከእኛ ይበረታሉና በዚህ ሕዝብ ላይ መውጣት አንችልም አሉ።

verses.en: But the men that went up with him said, We be not able to go up against the people; for they are stronger than we.
verses.am: ስለ ሰለሉአትም ምድር ክፉ ወሬ ለእስራኤል ልጆች እያወሩ። እኛ ዞረን የሰለልናት ምድር የሚኖሩባትን ሰዎች የምትበላ ምድር ናት፤ በእርስዋም ዘንድ ያየናቸው ሰዎች ሁሉ ረጃጅም ሰዎች ናቸው።

verses.en: And they brought up an evil report of the land which they had searched unto the children of Yisra'el, saying, The land, through which we have gone to search it, is a land that eateth up the inhabitants thereof; and all the people that we saw in it are men of a great stature.
verses.am: በዚያም ከኔፊሊም ወገን የሆኑትን ኔፊሊም፥ የዔናቅን ልጆች፥ አየን፤ እኛም በዓይናችን ግምት እንደ አንበጣዎች ነበርን፥ ደግሞም እኛ በዓይናቸው ዘንድ እንዲሁ ነበርን አሉ።

verses.en: And there we saw the giants, the sons of Anak, which come of the giants: and we were in our own sight as grasshoppers, and so we were in their sight.
And all the congregation lifted up their voice, and cried; and the people wept that night.
verses.am: ማኅበሩም ሁሉ ድምፃቸውን አንሥተው ጮኹ፤ ሕዝቡም በዚያ ሌሊት አለቀሱ።

verses.en: And all the children of Yisra'el murmured against Mosheh and against Aaron: and the whole congregation said unto them, Would YAHUAH that we had died in the land of Mitsrayim! or would YAHUAH we had died in this wilderness!
verses.am: የእስራኤልም ልጆች ሁሉ በሙሴና በአሮን ላይ አጕረመረሙ፤ ማኅበሩም ሁሉ። በግብፅ ምድር ሳለን ምነው በሞትን ኖሮ! ወይም በዚህ ምድረ በዳ ምነው በሞትን ኖሮ!

verses.en: And wherefore hath YAHUAH brought us unto this land, to fall by the sword, that our wives and our children should be a prey? were it not better for us to return into Mitsrayim?
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም በሰይፍ እንሞት ዘንድ ወደዚች ምድር ለምን ያገባናል? ሴቶቻችንና ልጆቻችን ምርኮ ይሆናሉ፤ ወደ ግብፅ መመለስ አይሻለንምን? አሉአቸው።

verses.en: And they said one to another, Let us make a captain, and let us return into Mitsrayim.
verses.am: እርስ በርሳቸውም። ኑ፥ አለቃ ሾመን ወደ ግብፅ እንመለስ ተባባሉ።

verses.en: Then Mosheh and Aaron fell on their faces before all the assembly of the congregation of the children of Yisra'el.
verses.am: ሙሴና አሮንም በእስራኤል ልጆች ጉባኤ ፊት በግምባራቸው ወደቁ።

verses.en: And Yahoshua the son of Nun, and Caleb the son of Jephunneh, which were of them that searched the land, rent their clothes:
verses.am: ምድርን ከሰለሉት ጋር የነበሩት የነዌ ልጅ ኢያሱና የዮፎኒ ልጅ ካሌብ ልብሳቸውን ቀደዱ፤

verses.en: And they spake unto all the company of the children of Yisra'el, saying, The land, which we passed through to search it, is an exceeding good land.
verses.am: ለእስራኤልም ልጆች ማኅበር ሁሉ። ዞረን የሰለልናት ምድር እጅግ መልካም ናት።

verses.en: If YAHUAH delight in us, then he will bring us into this land, and give it us; a land which floweth with milk and honey.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርስ ከወደደን ወተትና ማር ወደምታፈስሰው ወደዚች ምድር ያገባናል እርስዋንም ይሰጠናል።

verses.en: Only rebel not ye against YAHUAH, neither fear ye the people of the land; for they are bread for us: their defence is departed from them, and YAHUAH is with us: fear them not.
verses.am: ነገር ግን በእግዚአብሔር ላይ አታምፁ፤ እንደ እንጀራ ይሆኑልናልና የምድሪቱን ሰዎች አትፍሩ፤ ጥላቸው ከላያቸው ተገፍፎአል፥ እግዚአብሔርም ከእኛ ጋር ነው፤ አትፍሩአቸው ብለው ተናገሩአቸው።

verses.en: But all the congregation bade stone them with stones. And the glory of YAHUAH appeared in the tabernacle of the congregation before all the children of Yisra'el.
verses.am: ማኅበሩ ሁሉ ግን በድንጋይ ይወግሩአቸው ዘንድ ተማከሩ። የእግዚአብሔርም ክብር ለእስራኤል ልጆች ሁሉ በመገናኛው ድንኳን ተገለጠ።

verses.en: And YAHUAH said unto Mosheh, How long will this people provoke me? and how long will it be ere they believe me, for all the signs which I have shewed among them?
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን። ይህ ሕዝብ እስከ መቼ ይንቀኛል? በፊቱስ ባደረግሁት ተአምራት ሁሉ እስከ መቼ አያምንብኝም?

verses.en: I will smite them with the pestilence, and disinherit them, and will make of thee a greater nation and mightier than they.
verses.am: ከርስታቸው አጠፋቸው ዘንድ በቸነፈር እመታቸዋለሁ፤ አንተም ከእነርሱ ለሚበዛና ለሚጠነክር ሕዝብ አደርግሃለሁ አለው።

verses.en: And Mosheh said unto YAHUAH, Then the Mitsrim shall hear it, (for thou broughtest up this people in thy might from among them;)
verses.am: ሙሴም እግዚአብሔርን አለው። ግብፃውያን ይሰማሉ፤ ይህን ሕዝብ ከመካከላቸው በኃይልህ አውጥተኸዋልና፤

verses.en: And they will tell it to the inhabitants of this land: for they have heard that thou YAHUAH art among this people, that thou YAHUAH art seen face to face, and that thy cloud standeth over them, and that thou goest before them, by day time in a pillar of a cloud, and in a pillar of fire by night.
verses.am: ለዚችም ምድር ሰዎች ይናገራሉ። አንተ እግዚአብሔር በዚህ ሕዝብ መካከል እንደ ሆንህ ሰምተዋል፤ አንተም፥ አቤቱ፥ ፊት ለፊት ተገልጠሃል፥ ደመናህም በላያቸው ቆሞአል፥ በቀንም በደመና ዓምድ፥ በሌሊትም በእሳት ዓምድ በፊታቸው ትሄዳለህ።

verses.en: Now if thou shalt kill all this people as one man, then the nations which have heard the fame of thee will speak, saying,
verses.am: ይህን ሕዝብ እንደ አንድ ሰው ብትገድል ዝናህን የሰሙ አሕዛብ።

verses.en: Because YAHUAH was not able to bring this people into the land which he sware unto them, therefore he hath slain them in the wilderness.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ይህን ሕዝብ ወደ ማለላቸው ምድር ያገባቸው ዘንድ አልቻለምና በምድረ በዳ ገደላቸው ብለው ይናገራሉ።

verses.en: And now, I beseech thee, let the power of my Master be great, according as thou hast spoken, saying,
verses.am: ይህን ሕዝብ ከግብፅ ምድር ካወጣህ ጀምሮ እስከ ዛሬ ድረስ ይቅር እንዳልሃቸው፥ እባክህ፥ እንደ ምሕረትህ ብዛት የዚህን ሕዝብ ኃጢአት ይቅር በል።

verses.en: YAHUAH is longsuffering, and of great mercy, forgiving iniquity and transgression, and by no means clearing the guilty, visiting the iniquity of the fathers upon the children unto the third and fourth generation.
verses.am: ይህን ሕዝብ ከግብፅ ምድር ካወጣህ ጀምሮ እስከ ዛሬ ድረስ ይቅር እንዳልሃቸው፥ እባክህ፥ እንደ ምሕረትህ ብዛት የዚህን ሕዝብ ኃጢአት ይቅር በል።

verses.en: Pardon, I beseech thee, the iniquity of this people according unto the greatness of thy mercy, and as thou hast forgiven this people, from Mitsrayim even until now.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም አለ። እንደ ቃልህ ይቅር አልሁ፤

verses.en: And YAHUAH said, I have pardoned according to thy word:
verses.am: ነገር ግን እኔ ሕያው ነኛ በእውነት የእግዚአብሔር ክብር ምድርን ሁሉ ይሞላል።

verses.en: But as truly as I live, all the earth shall be filled with the glory of YAHUAH.
verses.am: በግብፅ ምድርና በምድረ በዳ ያደረግሁትን ተአምራቴንና ክብሬን ያዩ እነዚህ ሰዎች ሁሉ አሥር ጊዜ ስለ ተፈታተኑኝ፥

verses.en: Because all those men which have seen my glory, and my miracles, which I did in Mitsrayim and in the wilderness, and have tempted me now these ten times, and have not hearkened to my voice;
verses.am: ነገሬንም ስላልሰሙ፥ በእውነት ለአባቶቻቸው የማልሁላቸውን ምድር አያዩም፤ ከእነርሱም የናቀኝ ሰው ሁሉ አያያትም፤

verses.en: Surely they shall not see the land which I sware unto their fathers, neither shall any of them that provoked me see it:
verses.am: ባሪያዬ ካሌብ ግን ሌላ መንፈስ ከእርሱ ጋር ስለ ሆነ ፈጽሞም ስለተከተለኝ እርሱ ወደ ገባባት ምድር አገባዋለሁ፤ ዘሩም ይወርሳታል።

verses.en: But my servant Caleb, because he had another spirit with him, and hath followed me fully, him will I bring into the land whereinto he went; and his seed shall possess it.
verses.am: አማሌቅና ከነዓናዊውም በሸለቆው ውስጥ ተቀምጦአል፤ በነጋው ተመልሳችሁ በኤርትራ ባሕር መንገድ ወደ ምድረ በዳ ሂዱ።

verses.en: (Now the Amalekites and the Canaanites dwelt in the valley.) To morrow turn you, and get you into the wilderness by the way of the Red sea.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴንና አሮንን እንዲህ ብሎ ተናገራቸው።

verses.en: And YAHUAH spake unto Mosheh and unto Aaron, saying,
verses.am: የሚያጕረመርምብኝን ይህን ክፉ ሕዝብ እስከ መቼ እታገሠዋለሁ? በእኔ ላይ የሚያጕረመርሙትን የእስራኤልን ልጆች ማጕረምረም ሰማሁ።

verses.en: How long shall I bear with this evil congregation, which murmur against me? I have heard the murmurings of the children of Yisra'el, which they murmur against me.
verses.am: እንዲህ በላቸው። እኔ ሕያው ነኝና በጆሮዬ እንደ ተናገራችሁት እንዲሁ በእውነት አደርግባችኋለሁ፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር፤

verses.en: Say unto them, As truly as I live, saith YAHUAH, as ye have spoken in mine ears, so will I do to you:
verses.am: በድኖቻችሁ በዚህ ምድረ በዳ ይወድቃሉ፤ የተቆጠራችሁ ሁሉ፥ እንደቁጥራችሁ ከሀያ ዓመት ጀምሮ ከዚያም በላይ የሆነ ሁሉ፥ እናንተ ያጕረመረማችሁብኝ፥

verses.en: Your carcases shall fall in this wilderness; and all that were numbered of you, according to your whole number, from twenty years old and upward, which have murmured against me,
verses.am: ከዮፎኒ ልጅ ከካሌብና ከነዌ ልጅ ከኢያሱ በቀር በእርስዋ አስቀምጣችሁ ዘንድ እጄን ዘርግቼ ወደ ማልሁላችሁ ምድር በእውነት እናንተ አትገቡም።

verses.en: Doubtless ye shall not come into the land, concerning which I sware to make you dwell therein, save Caleb the son of Jephunneh, and Yahoshua the son of Nun.
verses.am: ምርኮኛ ይሆናሉ ያላችኋቸውን ልጆቻችሁን እነርሱን አገባቸዋለሁ፥ እናንተም የናቃችኋትን ምድር ያውቃሉ።

verses.en: But your little ones, which ye said should be a prey, them will I bring in, and they shall know the land which ye have despised.
verses.am: እናንተ ግን በድኖቻችሁ በዚህ ምድረ በዳ ይወድቃሉ።

verses.en: But as for you, your carcases, they shall fall in this wilderness.
verses.am: ልጆቻችሁም በምድረ በዳ አርባ ዓመት ይቅበዘበዛሉ፥ በድኖቻችሁም በምድረ በዳ እስኪጠፉ ድረስ ግልሙትናችሁን ይሸከማሉ።

verses.en: And your children shall wander in the wilderness forty years, and bear your whoredoms, until your carcases be wasted in the wilderness.
verses.am: ምድሪቱን በሰላለችሁባት ቀን ቍጥር፥ አርባ ቀን፥ ስለ አንድ ቀንም አንድ ዓመት፥ ኃጢአታችሁን አርባ ዓመት ትሸከማላችሁ፥ ቍጣዬንም ታውቃላችሁ።

verses.en: After the number of the days in which ye searched the land, even forty days, each day for a year, shall ye bear your iniquities, even forty years, and ye shall know my breach of promise.
verses.am: እኔ እግዚአብሔር። በእኔ ላይ በተሰበሰበ በዚህ ክፉ ማኅበር ሁሉ ላይ እንዲህ አደርጋለሁ ብዬ ተናገርሁ፤ በዚህ ምድረ በዳ ያልቃሉ፥ በዚያም ይሞታሉ።

verses.en: I YAHUAH have said, I will surely do it unto all this evil congregation, that are gathered together against me: in this wilderness they shall be consumed, and there they shall die.
verses.am: ምድሪቱንም ሊሰልሉ ሙሴ ልኮአቸው የተመለሱት ሰዎች ክፉ ወሬም ስለ ምድሪቱ እያወሩ በእርሱ ላይ ማኅበሩ ሁሉ እንዲያጕረመርሙ ያደረጉ፥

verses.en: And the men, which Mosheh sent to search the land, who returned, and made all the congregation to murmur against him, by bringing up a slander upon the land,
verses.am: ክፉ ወሬ ያወሩ እነዚያ ሰዎች በእግዚአብሔር ፊት በመቅሠፍት ሞቱ።

verses.en: Even those men that did bring up the evil report upon the land, died by the plague before YAHUAH.
verses.am: ነገር ግን ምድሪቱን ሊሰልሉ ከሄዱ ሰዎች የነዌ ልጅ ኢያሱና የዮፎኒ ልጅ ካሌብ በሕይወት ተቀመጡ።

verses.en: But Yahoshua the son of Nun, and Caleb the son of Jephunneh, which were of the men that went to search the land, lived still.
verses.am: ሙሴም ይህን ለእስራኤል ልጆች ሁሉ ነገረ፥ ሕዝቡም እጅግ አዘኑ።

verses.en: And Mosheh told these sayings unto all the children of Yisra'el: and the people mourned greatly.
verses.am: በነጋውም ማልደው ተነሡ፥ ወደ ተራራውም ራስ መጥተው። እነሆ፥ መጣን፤ እኛ በድለናልና እግዚአብሔር ወዳለው ስፍራ እንወጣለን አሉ።

verses.en: And they rose up early in the morning, and gat them up into the top of the mountain, saying, Lo, we be here, and will go up unto the place which YAHUAH hath promised: for we have sinned.
verses.am: ሙሴም አለ። የእግዚአብሔርን ትእዛዝ ለምን ትተላለፋላችሁ? አይጠቅማችሁም።

verses.en: And Mosheh said, Wherefore now do ye transgress the commandment of YAHUAH? but it shall not prosper.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር በእናንተ መካከል አይደለምና በጠላቶቻችሁ ፊት እንዳትወድቁ አትውጡ።

verses.en: Go not up, for YAHUAH is not among you; that ye be not smitten before your enemies.
verses.am: አማሌቃዊና ከነዓናዊ በፊታችሁ ናቸውና በሰይፍ ትወድቃላችሁ፤ እግዚአብሔርን ከመከተል ተመልሳችኋልና እግዚአብሔር ከእናንተ ጋር አይሆንም።

verses.en: For the Amalekites and the Canaanites are there before you, and ye shall fall by the sword: because ye are turned away from YAHUAH, therefore YAHUAH will not be with you.
verses.am: እነርሱ ግን ወደ ተራራው ራስ ሊወጡ ደፈሩ፤ ነገር ግን የእግዚአብሔር ቃል ኪዳን ታቦትና ሙሴ ከሰፈሩ አልተነሡም።

verses.en: But they presumed to go up unto the hill top: nevertheless the ark of the covenant of YAHUAH, and Mosheh, departed not out of the camp.
verses.am: በዚያም ተራራ ላይ የተቀመጡ አማሌቃዊና ከነዓናዊ ወረዱ፥ መትተዋቸውም እስከ ሔርማ ድረስ አሳደዱአቸው።

verses.en: Then the Amalekites came down, and the Canaanites which dwelt in that hill, and smote them, and discomfited them, even unto Hormah.
And YAHUAH spake unto Mosheh, saying,
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን እንዲህ ብሎ ተናገረው።

verses.en: Speak unto the children of Yisra'el, and say unto them, When ye be come into the land of your habitations, which I give unto you,
verses.am: ለእስራኤል ልጆች እንዲህ ብለህ ንገራቸው። ወደምሰጣችሁ ወደ መኖሪያችሁ ምድር በገባችሁ ጊዜ፥

verses.en: And will make an offering by fire unto YAHUAH, a burnt offering, or a sacrifice in performing a vow, or in a freewill offering, or in your solemn feasts, to make a sweet savour unto YAHUAH, of the herd, or of the flock:
verses.am: ስእለታችሁን ልትፈጽሙ፥ ወይም በፈቃዳችሁ፥ ወይም በበዓላችሁ፥ ለእግዚአብሔር ጣፋጭ ሽታ ታደርጉ ዘንድ ከበሬ ወይም ከበግ መንጋ የሚቃጠል መሥዋዕት ወይም መሥዋዕት የሚሆን የእሳት ቍርባን ለእግዚአብሔር ብታቀርቡ፥

verses.en: Then shall he that offereth his offering unto YAHUAH bring a meat offering of a tenth deal of flour mingled with the fourth part of an hin of oil.
verses.am: ቍርባኑን ለእግዚአብሔር የሚያቀርብ ከሚቃጠል መሥዋዕት ወይም ከሌላ መሥዋዕት ጋር ለእያንዳንዱ ጠቦት የኢን መስፈሪያ አራተኛ እጅ በሆነ ዘይት የተለወሰ ከመስፈሪያው ከአሥር እጅ አንድ እጅ የሆነ መልካም ዱቄት ለእህል ቍርባን፥ የኢን መስፈሪያ አራተኛ እጅ የወይን ጠጅ ለመጠጥ ቍርባን ያዘጋጃል።

verses.en: And the fourth part of an hin of wine for a drink offering shalt thou prepare with the burnt offering or sacrifice, for one lamb.
verses.am: ቍርባኑን ለእግዚአብሔር የሚያቀርብ ከሚቃጠል መሥዋዕት ወይም ከሌላ መሥዋዕት ጋር ለእያንዳንዱ ጠቦት የኢን መስፈሪያ አራተኛ እጅ በሆነ ዘይት የተለወሰ ከመስፈሪያው ከአሥር እጅ አንድ እጅ የሆነ መልካም ዱቄት ለእህል ቍርባን፥ የኢን መስፈሪያ አራተኛ እጅ የወይን ጠጅ ለመጠጥ ቍርባን ያዘጋጃል።

verses.en: Or for a ram, thou shalt prepare for a meat offering two tenth deals of flour mingled with the third part of an hin of oil.
verses.am: ለአንዱም አውራ በግ ለእግዚአብሔር ጣፋጭ ሽታ እንዲሆን የኢን መስፈሪያ ሢሶ በሆነ ዘይት የተለወሰ ከመስፈሪያው ከአሥር እጅ ሁለት እጅ መልካም ዱቄት ለእህል ቍርባን ታዘጋጃለህ፤ የኢን መስፈሪያ ሢሶም የወይን ጠጅ ለመጠጥ ቍርባን ታቀርባለህ።

verses.en: And for a drink offering thou shalt offer the third part of an hin of wine, for a sweet savour unto YAHUAH.
verses.am: ለአንዱም አውራ በግ ለእግዚአብሔር ጣፋጭ ሽታ እንዲሆን የኢን መስፈሪያ ሢሶ በሆነ ዘይት የተለወሰ ከመስፈሪያው ከአሥር እጅ ሁለት እጅ መልካም ዱቄት ለእህል ቍርባን ታዘጋጃለህ፤ የኢን መስፈሪያ ሢሶም የወይን ጠጅ ለመጠጥ ቍርባን ታቀርባለህ።

verses.en: And when thou preparest a bullock for a burnt offering, or for a sacrifice in performing a vow, or peace offerings unto YAHUAH:
verses.am: ለሚቃጠልም መሥዋዕት ወይም ለሌላ መሥዋዕት ወይም ስእለትን ለመፈጸም ወይም ለደኅንነት መሥዋዕት ወይፈንን ለእግዚአብሔር ብታዘጋጅ፥

verses.en: Then shall he bring with a bullock a meat offering of three tenth deals of flour mingled with half an hin of oil.
verses.am: ከወይፈኑ ጋር የኢን መስፈሪያ ግማሽ በሆነ ዘይት የተለወሰ ከመስፈሪያው ከአሥር እጅ ሦስት እጅ መልካም ዱቄት ለእህል ቍርባን ታቀርባለህ።

verses.en: And thou shalt bring for a drink offering half an hin of wine, for an offering made by fire, of a sweet savour unto YAHUAH.
verses.am: ለእግዚአብሔር ጣፋጭ ሽታ እንዲሆን በእሳት ለተደረገ ቍርባን፥ የኢን መስፈሪያ ግማሽ የወይን ጠጅ ለመጠጥ ቍርባን ታቀርባለ።

verses.en: Thus shall it be done for one bullock, or for one ram, or for a lamb, or a kid.
verses.am: እንዲሁ ለእያንዳንዱ ወይፈን ወይም ለእያንዳንዱ አውራ በግ ወይም ለእያንዳንዱ ተባት የበግ ወይም የፍየል ጠቦት ይደረጋል።

verses.en: According to the number that ye shall prepare, so shall ye do to every one according to their number.
verses.am: እንዳዘጋጃችሁት ቍጥር፥ እንዲሁ እንደ ቍጥራቸው ለእያንዳንዱ ታደርጋላችሁ።

verses.en: All that are born of the country shall do these things after this manner, in offering an offering made by fire, of a sweet savour unto YAHUAH.
verses.am: የአገር ልጅ ሁሉ ለእግዚአብሔር ጣፋጭ ሽታ እንዲሆን ቍርባን በእሳት ባቀረበ ጊዜ እንዲሁ ያደርጋል።

verses.en: And if a stranger sojourn with you, or whosoever be among you in your generations, and will offer an offering made by fire, of a sweet savour unto YAHUAH; as ye do, so he shall do.
verses.am: መጻተኛም ከእናንተ ጋር ቢቀመጥ፥ ወይም በትውልዳችሁ መካከል ማንም ሰው ቢኖር፥ ለእግዚአብሔር ጣፋጭ ሽታ እንዲሆን ቍርባን በእሳት ቢያቀርብ፥ እናንተ የምታደርጉትን እርሱ እንዲሁ ያደርጋል።

verses.en: One ordinance shall be both for you of the congregation, and also for the stranger that sojourneth with you, an ordinance for ever in your generations: as ye are, so shall the stranger be before YAHUAH.
verses.am: ለእናንተ በጉባኤው ላላችሁ በእናንተም መካከል ለሚቀመጥ መጻተኛ አንድ ሥርዓት ይሆናል፥ ለልጅ ልጃችሁም የዘላለም ሥርዓት ይሆናል፤ እናንተ እንደ ሆናችሁ እንዲሁ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት መጻተኛ ይሆናል።

verses.en: One law and one manner shall be for you, and for the stranger that sojourneth with you.
verses.am: ለእናንተና ከእናንተ ጋር ለሚቀመጥ መጻተኛ አንድ ሕግና አንድ ፍርድ ይሆናል።

verses.en: And YAHUAH spake unto Mosheh, saying,
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን እንዲህ ብሎ ተናገረው።

verses.en: Speak unto the children of Yisra'el, and say unto them, When ye come into the land whither I bring you,
verses.am: ለእስራኤል ልጆች እንዲህ ብለህ ንገራቸው። ወደማመጣችሁ ምድር በገባችሁ ጊዜ፥

verses.en: Then it shall be, that, when ye eat of the bread of the land, ye shall offer up an heave offering unto YAHUAH.
verses.am: እናንተ የምድሪቱን እንጀራ በበላችሁ ጊዜ ለእግዚአብሔር የማንሣት ቍርባን ታደርጋላችሁ።

verses.en: Ye shall offer up a cake of the first of your dough for an heave offering: as ye do the heave offering of the threshingfloor, so shall ye heave it.
verses.am: መጀመሪያ ከምታደርጉት ሊጥ አንድ እንጐቻ ለማንሣት ቍርባን ታቀርባላችሁ፤ ከአውድማም እንደምታነሡት ቍርባን እንዲሁ ታነሣላችሁ።

verses.en: Of the first of your dough ye shall give unto YAHUAH an heave offering in your generations.
verses.am: መጀመሪያ ከምታደርጉት ሊጥ የማንሣት ቍርባን እስከ ልጅ ልጃችሁ ለእግዚአብሔር ትሰጣላችሁ።

verses.en: And if ye have erred, and not observed all these commandments, which YAHUAH hath spoken unto Mosheh,
verses.am: ብትስቱም፥ እግዚአብሔርም ለሙሴ ያዘዛቸውን እነዚህን ትእዛዛት ሁሉ ባታደርጉ፥

verses.en: Even all that YAHUAH hath commanded you by the hand of Mosheh, from the day that YAHUAH commanded Mosheh, and henceforward among your generations;
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ካዘዘበት ከፊተኛው ቀን ጀምሮ ወደ ፊትም እስከ ልጅ ልጃችሁ እግዚአብሔር በሙሴ እጅ ያዘዛችሁን ሁሉ ባታደርጉ፥

verses.en: Then it shall be, if ought be committed by ignorance without the knowledge of the congregation, that all the congregation shall offer one young bullock for a burnt offering, for a sweet savour unto YAHUAH, with his meat offering, and his drink offering, according to the manner, and one kid of the goats for a sin offering.
verses.am: ማኅበሩ ሳያውቁ በስሕተት ቢደረግ፥ ማኅበሩ ሁሉ ለሚቃጠል መሥዋዕት ከእህሉ ቍርባንና ከመጠጡ ቍርባን ጋር እንደ ሕጉ ለእግዚአብሔር ጣፋጭ ሽታ እንዲሆን አንድ ወይፈን፥ ለኃጢአትም መሥዋዕት አንድ አውራ ፍየል ያቀርባሉ።

verses.en: And the priest shall make an atonement for all the congregation of the children of Yisra'el, and it shall be forgiven them; for it is ignorance: and they shall bring their offering, a sacrifice made by fire unto YAHUAH, and their sin offering before YAHUAH, for their ignorance:
verses.am: ካህኑም ለእስራኤል ልጆች ማኅበር ሁሉ ያስተሰርይላቸዋል፥ ስሕተትም ነበረና ይሰረይላቸዋል፤ ስለ ስሕተታቸውም ለእግዚአብሔር ቍርባናቸውን በእሳት አቅርበዋል፥ ለእግዚአብሔርም የኃጢአታቸውን መሥዋዕት አቅርበዋል።

verses.en: And it shall be forgiven all the congregation of the children of Yisra'el, and the stranger that sojourneth among them; seeing all the people were in ignorance.
verses.am: በሕዝቡም ሁሉ ዘንድ ያለ እውቀት ተደርጎአልና ለእስራኤል ልጆች ማኅበር ሁሉ በመካከላቸውም ለሚኖሩት መጻተኞች ስርየት ይደረግላቸዋል።

verses.en: And if any soul sin through ignorance, then he shall bring a she goat of the first year for a sin offering.
verses.am: አንድ ሰው ሳያውቅ ኃጢአት ቢሠራ፥ ለኃጢአት መሥዋዕት አንዲት የአንድ ዓመት እንስት ፍየል ያቀርባል።

verses.en: And the priest shall make an atonement for the soul that sinneth ignorantly, when he sinneth by ignorance before YAHUAH, to make an atonement for him; and it shall be forgiven him.
verses.am: ኃጢአት ሠርቶ ሳያውቅ፥ ለሳተ ለዚያ ሰው ካህኑ ያስተሰርይለታል፤ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ያስተሰርይለታል፥ ይሰረይለትማል።

verses.en: Ye shall have one law for him that sinneth through ignorance, both for him that is born among the children of Yisra'el, and for the stranger that sojourneth among them.
verses.am: ትውልዱ በእስራኤል ልጆች መካከል ቢሆን፥ ወይም በመካከላቸው የሚቀመጥ መጻተኛ ቢሆን፥ ሳያውቅ ኃጢአትን ለሚሠራ ሁሉ ሕጉ አንድ ይሆንለታል።

verses.en: But the soul that doeth ought presumptuously, whether he be born in the land, or a stranger, the same reproacheth YAHUAH; and that soul shall be cut off from among his people.
verses.am: የአገር ልጅ ቢሆን ወይም መጻተኛ ቢሆን፥ አንዳች በትዕቢት የሚያደርግ ሰው እግዚአብሔርን ሰድቦአል፤ ያም ሰው ከሕዝቡ መካከል ተለይቶ ይጠፋል።

verses.en: Because he hath despised the word of YAHUAH, and hath broken his commandment, that soul shall utterly be cut off; his iniquity shall be upon him.
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔርን ቃል ስለ ናቀ፥ ትእዛዙንም ስለ ሰበረ፥ ያ ሰው ፈጽሞ ይጥፋ፤ ኃጢአቱ በራሱ ላይ ነው።

verses.en: And while the children of Yisra'el were in the wilderness, they found a man that gathered sticks upon the sabbath day.
verses.am: የእስራኤልም ልጆች በምድረ በዳ ሳሉ አንድ ሰው በሰንበት ቀን እንጨት ሲለቅም አገኙ።

verses.en: And they that found him gathering sticks brought him unto Mosheh and Aaron, and unto all the congregation.
verses.am: እንጨትም ሲለቅም ያገኙት ሰዎች ወደ ሙሴና ወደ አሮን ወደ ማኅበሩም ሁሉ አመጡት።

verses.en: And they put him in ward, because it was not declared what should be done to him.
verses.am: ያደርጉበትም ዘንድ የሚገባው አልተገለጠምና በግዞት አስቀመጡት።

verses.en: And YAHUAH said unto Mosheh, The man shall be surely put to death: all the congregation shall stone him with stones without the camp.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን። ሰውየው ፈጽሞ ይገደል፤ ከሰፈሩ ውጭ ማኅበሩ ሁሉ በድንጋይ ይውገሩት አለው።

verses.en: And all the congregation brought him without the camp, and stoned him with stones, and he died; as YAHUAH commanded Mosheh.
verses.am: ማኅበሩም ሁሉ ከሰፈሩ ወደ ውጭ አወጡት፥ እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን እንዳዘዘው እስኪሞት ድረስ በድንጋይ ወገሩት።

verses.en: And YAHUAH spake unto Mosheh, saying,
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን እንዲህ ብሎ ተናገረው።

verses.en: Speak unto the children of Yisra'el, and bid them that they make them fringes in the borders of their garments throughout their generations, and that they put upon the fringe of the borders a ribband of blue:
verses.am: ለእስራኤል ልጆች እንዲህ በላቸው። እነርሱም ትውልዶቻቸውም በልብሳቸው ጫፍ ዘርፍ ያደርጉ ዘንድ፥ በዘርፉም ሁሉ ላይ ሰማያዊ ፈትል ያደርጉ ዘንድ እዘዛቸው።

verses.en: And it shall be unto you for a fringe, that ye may look upon it, and remember all the commandments of YAHUAH, and do them; and that ye seek not after your own heart and your own eyes, after which ye use to go a whoring:
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔርንም ትእዛዝ ሁሉ ታስቡና ታደርጉ ዘንድ፥ እርስዋን በመከተል ያመነዘራችሁባትን የልባችሁንና የዓይኖቻችሁን ፈቃድ እንዳትከተሉ፥

verses.en: That ye may remember, and do all my commandments, and be holy unto your YAHUAH.
verses.am: ትእዛዜን ሁሉ ታስቡና ታደርጉ ዘንድ፥ ለአምላካችሁም ቅዱሳን ትሆኑ ዘንድ ዘርፉ በልብሳችሁ ላይ እንዲታይ ይሁን።

verses.en: I am YAHUAH your YAHUAH, which brought you out of the land of Mitsrayim, to be your YAHUAH: I am YAHUAH your YAHUAH.
verses.am: እኔ እግዚአብሔር አምላካችሁ ነኝ፤ አምላክ እሆናችሁ ዘንድ ከግብፅ ምድር ያወጣኋችሁ እኔ እግዚአብሔር አምላካችሁ ነኝ።

verses.en: Now Korah, the son of Izhar, the son of Kohath, the son of Levi, and Dathan and Abiram, the sons of Eliab, and On, the son of Peleth, sons of Reuben, took men:
verses.am: የሌዊም ልጅ የቀዓት ልጅ የይስዓር ልጅ ቆሬ ከሮቤልም ልጆች የኤልያብ ልጆች ዳታንና አቤሮን የፋሌትም ልጅ ኦን በሙሴ ላይ ተነሡ። ች የኤልያብ ልጆች ዳታንና አቤሮን የፋሌትም ልጅ ኦን በሙሴ

verses.en: And they rose up before Mosheh, with certain of the children of Yisra'el, two hundred and fifty princes of the assembly, famous in the congregation, men of renown:
verses.am: ከእስራኤልም ልጆች ሁለት መቶ አምሳ ሰዎች ከእነርሱ ጋር ወሰዱ፤ ከጉባኤው የተመረጡ ዝናቸውም የተሰማ የማኅበሩ አለቆች ነበሩ።

verses.en: And they gathered themselves together against Mosheh and against Aaron, and said unto them, Ye take too much upon you, seeing all the congregation are holy, every one of them, and YAHUAH is among them: wherefore then lift ye up yourselves above the congregation of YAHUAH?
verses.am: በሙሴና በአሮን ላይ ተሰብስበው። ማኅበሩ ሁሉ እያንዳንዳቸው ቅዱሳን ናቸውና፥ እግዚአብሔርም በመካከላቸው ነውና እናንተ እጅግ አብዝታችኋል፤ በእግዚአብሔርም ጉባኤ ላይ ለምን ትታበያላችሁ? አሉ።

verses.en: And when Mosheh heard it, he fell upon his face:
verses.am: ሙሴም በሰማ ጊዜ በግምባሩ ወደቀ፤

verses.en: And he spake unto Korah and unto all his company, saying, Even to morrow YAHUAH will shew who are his, and who is holy; and will cause him to come near unto him: even him whom he hath chosen will he cause to come near unto him.
verses.am: ለቆሬም ለወገኑም ሁሉ። ነገ እግዚአብሔር ለእርሱ የሚሆነውን፥ ቅዱስም የሚሆነውን ያስታውቃል፤ የመረጠውንም ሰው ወደ እርሱ ያቀርበዋል።

verses.en: This do; Take you censers, Korah, and all his company;
verses.am: እንዲሁ አድርጉ፤ ቆሬና ወገንህ ሁሉ፥ ጥናዎቹን ውሰዱ፤

verses.en: And put fire therein, and put incense in them before YAHUAH to morrow: and it shall be that the man whom YAHUAH doth choose, he shall be holy: ye take too much upon you, ye sons of Levi.
verses.am: ነገም በእግዚአብሔር ፊት እሳት አድርጉባቸው፥ ዕጣንም ጨምሩባቸው፤ እንዲህም ይሆናል፤ እግዚአብሔር የሚመርጠው እርሱ ቅዱስ ይሆናል፤ እናንተ የሌዊ ልጆች ሆይ እጅግ አብዝታችኋል ብሎ ተናገራቸው።

verses.en: And Mosheh said unto Korah, Hear, I pray you, ye sons of Levi:
verses.am: ሙሴም ቆሬን አለው። እናንተ የሌዊ ልጆች፥ ስሙ፤

verses.en: Seemeth it but a small thing unto you, that YAHUAH of Yisra'el hath separated you from the congregation of Yisra'el, to bring you near to himself to do the service of the tabernacle of YAHUAH, and to stand before the congregation to minister unto them?
verses.am: የእስራኤል አምላክ ከእስራኤል ማኅበር የለያችሁ፥ የእግዚአብሔርንም ማደሪያ አገልግሎት ትሠሩ ዘንድ፥ እንድታገለግሉአቸውም በማኅበሩ ፊት ትቆሙ ዘንድ ወደ እርሱ ያቀረባችሁ አይበቃችሁምን?

verses.en: And he hath brought thee near to him, and all thy brethren the sons of Levi with thee: and seek ye the priesthood also?
verses.am: አንተን ከአንተም ጋር የሌዊን ልጆች ወንድሞችህን ሁሉ ወደ እርሱ አቅርቦአል፤ ክህነትንም ደግሞ ትፈልጋላችሁን?

verses.en: For which cause both thou and all thy company are gathered together against YAHUAH: and what is Aaron, that ye murmur against him?
verses.am: ስለዚህም አንተና ወገንህ ሁሉ በእግዚአብሔር ላይ ተሰብስባችኋል፤ በእርሱም ላይ ታጕረመርሙ ዘንድ አሮን ማን ነው?

verses.en: And Mosheh sent to call Dathan and Abiram, the sons of Eliab: which said, We will not come up:
verses.am: ሙሴም የኤልያብን ልጆች ዳታንና አቤሮንን እንዲጠሩአቸው ላከ፤ እነርሱም። አንመጣም፤

verses.en: Is it a small thing that thou hast brought us up out of a land that floweth with milk and honey, to kill us in the wilderness, except thou make thyself altogether a prince over us?
verses.am: በምድረ በዳ ትገድለን ዘንድ ወተትና ማር ከምታፈስሰው ምድር ያወጣኸን አይበቃህምን? ደግመህ በእኛ ላይ ራስህን አለቃ ታደርጋለህን?

verses.en: Moreover thou hast not brought us into a land that floweth with milk and honey, or given us inheritance of fields and vineyards: wilt thou put out the eyes of these men? we will not come up.
verses.am: ደግሞ ወተትና ማር ወደምታፈስስ ምድር አላገባኸንም፥ እርሻና ወይንም አላወረስኸንም፤ የእነዚህንስ ሰዎች ዓይኖቻቸውን ታወጣለህን? አንመጣም አሉ።

verses.en: And Mosheh was very wroth, and said unto YAHUAH, Respect not thou their offering: I have not taken one ass from them, neither have I hurt one of them.
verses.am: ሙሴም እጅግ ተቈጣ፥ እግዚአብሔርንም። ወደ ቍርባናቸው አትመልከት፤ እኔ ከእነርሱ አንድ አህያ ስንኳ አልወሰድሁም፥ ከእነርሱም አንድ ሰው አልበደልሁም አለው።

verses.en: And Mosheh said unto Korah, Be thou and all thy company before YAHUAH, thou, and they, and Aaron, to morrow:
verses.am: ሙሴም ቆሬን። ነገ አንተ፥ ወገንህም ሁሉ፥ አሮንም በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ሁኑ፤

verses.en: And take every man his censer, and put incense in them, and bring ye before YAHUAH every man his censer, two hundred and fifty censers; thou also, and Aaron, each of you his censer.
verses.am: ሁላችሁም ጥናዎቻችሁን ውሰዱ፥ ዕጣንም አድርጉባቸው፥ እያንዳንዳችሁም ጥናዎቻችሁን ወደ እግዚአብሔር ፊት አምጡ፥ ሁለት መቶ አምሳ ጥናዎች፤ አንተ ደግሞ አሮንም ጥናዎቻችሁን አምጡ አለው።

verses.en: And they took every man his censer, and put fire in them, and laid incense thereon, and stood in the door of the tabernacle of the congregation with Mosheh and Aaron.
verses.am: እያንዳንዱም ጥናውን ወሰደ፥ እሳትም አደረገበት፥ ዕጣንም ጨመረበት፥ ከሙሴና ከአሮንም ጋር በመገናኛው ድንኳን ደጃፍ ቆመ።

verses.en: And Korah gathered all the congregation against them unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation: and the glory of YAHUAH appeared unto all the congregation.
verses.am: ቆሬም ማኅበሩን ሁሉ ወደ መገናኛው ድንኳን ደጃፍ በእነርሱ ላይ ሰበሰበ፤ የእግዚአብሔርም ክብር ለማኅበሩ ሁሉ ተገለጠ።

verses.en: And YAHUAH spake unto Mosheh and unto Aaron, saying,
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴንና አሮንን እንዲህ ብሎ ተናገራቸው።

verses.en: Separate yourselves from among this congregation, that I may consume them in a moment.
verses.am: ሁሉን በቅጽበት አጠፋቸው ዘንድ ከዚህ ማኅበር መካከል ፈቀቅ በሉ።

verses.en: And they fell upon their faces, and said, O YAHUAH, YAHUAH of the spirits of all flesh, shall one man sin, and wilt thou be wroth with all the congregation?
verses.am: እነርሱም በግምባራቸው ወድቀው። አምላክ ሆይ፥ አንተ የሰው ሁሉ ነፍስ አምላክ፥ አንድ ሰው ኃጢአት ቢሠራ አንተ በማኅበሩ ሁሉ ላይ ትቈጣለህን? አሉ።

verses.en: And YAHUAH spake unto Mosheh, saying,
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን እንዲህ ብሎ ተናገረው።

verses.en: Speak unto the congregation, saying, Get you up from about the tabernacle of Korah, Dathan, and Abiram.
verses.am: ለማኅበሩ። ከቆሬና ከዳታን ከአቤሮንም ማደሪያ ዙሪያ ፈቀቅ በሉ ብለህ ንገራቸው።

verses.en: And Mosheh rose up and went unto Dathan and Abiram; and the elders of Yisra'el followed him.
verses.am: ሙሴም ተነሥቶ ወደ ዳታንና ወደ አቤሮን ሄደ፤ የእስራኤልም ሽማግሌዎች ተከተሉት።

verses.en: And he spake unto the congregation, saying, Depart, I pray you, from the tents of these wicked men, and touch nothing of theirs, lest ye be consumed in all their sins.
verses.am: ማኅበሩንም። እባካችሁ፥ ከእነዚህ ክፉዎች ድንኳን ፈቀቅ በሉ፤ በኃጢአታቸውም ሁሉ እንዳትጠፉ ለእነርሱ የሆነውን ሁሉ አትንኩ ብሎ ተናገራቸው።

verses.en: So they gat up from the tabernacle of Korah, Dathan, and Abiram, on every side: and Dathan and Abiram came out, and stood in the door of their tents, and their wives, and their sons, and their little children.
verses.am: ከቆሬና ከዳታን ከአቤሮንም ማደሪያ ከዙሪያውም ሁሉ ፈቀቅ አሉ፤ ዳታንና አቤሮንም ሴቶቻቸውም ልጆቻቸውም ሕፃናቶቻቸውም ወጥተው በድንኳኖቻቸው ደጃፍ ቆሙ።

verses.en: And Mosheh said, Hereby ye shall know that YAHUAH hath sent me to do all these works; for I have not done them of mine own mind.
verses.am: ሙሴም አለ። ይህን ሥራ ሁሉ አደርግ ዘንድ እግዚአብሔር እንደ ላከኝ እንጂ ከልቤ እንዳይደለ በዚህ ታውቃላችሁ።

verses.en: If these men die the common death of all men, or if they be visited after the visitation of all men; then YAHUAH hath not sent me.
verses.am: እነዚህ ሰዎች ሰው እንደሚሞት ቢሞቱ፥ ወይም እንደ ሰው ሁሉ ቢቀሠፉ እግዚአብሔር አልላከኝም።

verses.en: But if YAHUAH make a new thing, and the earth open her mouth, and swallow them up, with all that appertain unto them, and they go down quick into the pit; then ye shall understand that these men have provoked YAHUAH.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ግን አዲስ ነገር ቢፈጥር፥ ምድርም አፍዋን ከፍታ እነርሱን ለእነርሱም ያለውን ሁሉ ብትውጣቸው፥ በሕይወታቸውም ወደ ሲኦል ቢወርዱ፥ ያን ጊዜ እነዚህ ሰዎች እግዚአብሔርን እንደ ናቁ ታውቃላችሁ።

verses.en: And it came to pass, as he had made an end of speaking all these words, that the ground clave asunder that was under them:
verses.am: እንዲህም ሆነ፤ ይህን ቃል ሁሉ መናገር በፈጸመ ጊዜ ከበታቻቸው ያለው መሬት ተሰነጠቀ፤

verses.en: And the earth opened her mouth, and swallowed them up, and their houses, and all the men that appertained unto Korah, and all their goods.
verses.am: ምድሪቱም አፍዋን ከፍታ እነርሱን ቤተ ሰቦቻቸውንም፥ ለቆሬም የነበሩትን ሰዎች ሁሉ፥ ዕቃዎቻቸውንም ሁሉ ዋጠቻቸው።

verses.en: They, and all that appertained to them, went down alive into the pit, and the earth closed upon them: and they perished from among the congregation.
verses.am: እነርሱም ለእነርሱም የነበሩ ሁሉ በሕይወታቸው ወደ ሲኦል ወረዱ፤ ምድሪቱም ተዘጋችባቸው፥ ከጉባኤውም መካከል ጠፉ።

verses.en: And all Yisra'el that were round about them fled at the cry of them: for they said, Lest the earth swallow us up also.
verses.am: በዙሪያቸው የነበሩ የእስራኤል ልጆች ሁሉ ከጩኸታቸው የተነሣ። ምድሪቱ እንዳትውጠን ብለው በረሩ።

verses.en: And there came out a fire from YAHUAH, and consumed the two hundred and fifty men that offered incense.
verses.am: እሳትም ከእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ ወጥታ ያጥኑ የነበሩትን ሁለት መቶ አምሳ ሰዎች በላች።

verses.en: And YAHUAH spake unto Mosheh, saying,
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን እንዲህ ብሎ ተናገረው።

verses.en: Speak unto Eleazar the son of Aaron the priest, that he take up the censers out of the burning, and scatter thou the fire yonder; for they are hallowed.
verses.am: ለካህኑ ለአሮን ልጅ ለአልዓዛር እንዲህ ብለህ ንገረው። ተቀድሰዋልና ጥናዎቹን ከተቃጠሉት ዘንድ ውሰድ፥ እሳቱንም ወደ ውጭ ጣለው፤

verses.en: The censers of these sinners against their own souls, let them make them broad plates for a covering of the altar: for they offered them before YAHUAH, therefore they are hallowed: and they shall be a sign unto the children of Yisra'el.
verses.am: በኃጢአታቸው ሰውነታቸውን ያጠፉትን የእነዚያን ሰዎች ጥናዎች ጠፍጥፈህ ለመሠዊያ መለበጫ አድርጋቸው፤ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት አቅርበዋቸዋልና የተቀደሱ ናቸው፥ ለእስራኤልም ልጆች ምልክት ይሆናሉ።

verses.en: And Eleazar the priest took the brasen censers, wherewith they that were burnt had offered; and they were made broad plates for a covering of the altar:
verses.am: ካህኑም አልዓዛር የተቃጠሉት ሰዎች ያቀረቡአቸውን የናስ ጥናዎች ወስዶ ጠፍጥፎም ለመሠዊያው መለበጫ አደረጋቸው።

verses.en: To be a memorial unto the children of Yisra'el, that no stranger, which is not of the seed of Aaron, come near to offer incense before YAHUAH; that he be not as Korah, and as his company: as YAHUAH said to him by the hand of Mosheh.
verses.am: በቆሬና በወገኑ የደረሰው እንዳይደርስበት፥ ከአሮን ልጆች ያልሆነ ሌላ ሰው በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ዕጣን ያጥን ዘንድ እንዳይቀርብ፥ እግዚአብሔር በሙሴ እንደ ተናገረው፥ ለእስራኤል ልጆች መታሰቢያ አደረጋቸው።

verses.en: But on the morrow all the congregation of the children of Yisra'el murmured against Mosheh and against Aaron, saying, Ye have killed the people of YAHUAH.
verses.am: በነጋውም የእስራኤል ልጆች ማኅበር ሁሉ። እናንተ የእግዚአብሔርን ሕዝብ ገድላችኋል ብለው በሙሴና በአሮን ላይ አጕረመረሙ።

verses.en: And it came to pass, when the congregation was gathered against Mosheh and against Aaron, that they looked toward the tabernacle of the congregation: and, behold, the cloud covered it, and the glory of YAHUAH appeared.
verses.am: እንዲህም ሆነ፤ ማኅበሩ በሙሴና በአሮን ላይ በተሰበሰቡ ጊዜ ወደ መገናኛው ድንኳን አዩ፤ እነሆም፥ ደመናው ሸፈነው፥ የእግዚአብሔርም ክብር ተገለጠ።

verses.en: And Mosheh and Aaron came before the tabernacle of the congregation.
verses.am: ሙሴና አሮንም ወደ መገናኛው ድንኳን ፊት መጡ።

verses.en: And YAHUAH spake unto Mosheh, saying,
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ሙሴን እንዲህ ብሎ ተናገረው።

verses.en: Get you up from among this congregation, that I may consume them as in a moment. And they fell upon their faces.
verses.am: ከዚህ ማኅበር መካከል ፈቀቅ በሉ፥ እኔም በቅጽበት አጠፋቸዋለሁ። በግምባራቸውም ወደቁ።

verses.en: And Mosheh said unto Aaron, Take a censer, and put fire therein from off the altar, and put on incense, and go quickly unto the congregation, and make an atonement for them: for there is wrath gone out from YAHUAH; the plague is begun.
verses.am: ሙሴም አሮንን። ጥናህን ውሰድ፥ ከመሠዊያውም ላይ እሳት አድርግበት፥ ዕጣንም ጨምርበት፥ ወደ ማኅበሩም ፈጥነህ ውሰደው አስተስርይላቸውም፤ ከእግዚአብሔር ፊት ቍጣ ወጥቶአልና መቅሠፍት ጀምሮአል አለው።

verses.en: And Aaron took as Mosheh commanded, and ran into the midst of the congregation; and, behold, the plague was begun among the people: and he put on incense, and made an atonement for the people.
verses.am: አሮንም ሙሴ እንደ ተናገረው ጥናውን ወስዶ ወደ ጉባኤው መካከል ሮጠ፤ እነሆም፥ መቅሠፍቱ በሕዝቡ መካከል ጀምሮ ነበር፤ ዕጣንም ጨመረ፥ ለሕዝቡም አስተሰረየላቸው።

verses.en: And he stood between the dead and the living; and the plague was stayed.
verses.am: በሙታንና በሕያዋን መካከል ቆመ፤ መቅሠፍቱም ተከለከለ።

verses.en: Now they that died in the plague were fourteen thousand and seven hundred, beside them that died about the matter of Korah.
verses.am: በቆሬም ምክንያት ከሞቱት ሌላ በመቅሠፍቱ የሞቱት አሥራ አራት ሺህ ሰባት መቶ ነበሩ።

verses.en: And Aaron returned unto Mosheh unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation: and the plague was stayed.
verses.am: አሮንም ወደ ሙሴ ወደ መገናኛው ድንኳን ደጃፍ ተመለሰ፤ መቅሠፍቱም ተከለከለ።

verses.en: And YAHUAH spake unto Mosheh, saying,
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን እንዲህ ብሎ ተናገረው።

verses.en: Speak unto the children of Yisra'el, and take of every one of them a rod according to the house of their fathers, of all their princes according to the house of their fathers twelve rods: write thou every man's name upon his rod.
verses.am: ለእስራኤል ልጆች ንገራቸው፥ ከእነርሱም ከእያንዳንዱ ከየአባቶቻቸው ቤት አንድ አንድ በትር፥ ከአለቆቻቸው ከየአባቶቻቸው ቤት አሥራ ሁለት በትሮች፥ ውሰድ፤ የእያንዳንዱንም ስም በየበትሩ ላይ ጻፍ።

verses.en: And thou shalt write Aaron's name upon the rod of Levi: for one rod shall be for the head of the house of their fathers.
verses.am: አንድ በትርም ለአባቶቻቸው ቤት አለቃ ይሆናልና በሌዊ በትር ላይ የአሮንን ስም ጻፍ።

verses.en: And thou shalt lay them up in the tabernacle of the congregation before the testimony, where I will meet with you.
verses.am: እኔ ከእናንተ ጋር በምገናኝበት በመገናኛው ድንኳን ውስጥ በምስክሩ ፊት አኑራቸው።

verses.en: And it shall come to pass, that the man's rod, whom I shall choose, shall blossom: and I will make to cease from me the murmurings of the children of Yisra'el, whereby they murmur against you.
verses.am: እንዲህም ይሆናል፤ የመረጥሁት ሰው በትር ታቈጠቁጣለች፤ በእናንተም ላይ የሚያጕረመርሙባችሁን የእስራኤልን ልጆች ማጕረምረም ከእኔ ዘንድ አጠፋለሁ።

verses.en: And Mosheh spake unto the children of Yisra'el, and every one of their princes gave him a rod apiece, for each prince one, according to their fathers' houses, even twelve rods: and the rod of Aaron was among their rods.
verses.am: ሙሴም ለእስራኤል ልጆች ተናገራቸው፤ አለቆቻቸው ሁሉ አሥራ ሁለት በትሮች፥ እያንዳንዱም አለቃ በየአባቱ ቤት አንድ አንድ በትር፥ ሰጡት፤ የአሮንም በትር በበትሮቻቸው መካከል ነበረች።

verses.en: And Mosheh laid up the rods before YAHUAH in the tabernacle of witness.
verses.am: ሙሴም በትሮቹን በእግዚአብሔር ፊት በምስክሩ ድንኳን ውስጥ አኖራቸው።

verses.en: And it came to pass, that on the morrow Mosheh went into the tabernacle of witness; and, behold, the rod of Aaron for the house of Levi was budded, and brought forth buds, and bloomed blossoms, and yielded almonds.
verses.am: እንዲህም ሆነ፤ በነጋው ሙሴ ወደ ምስክሩ ድንኳን ውስጥ ገባ፤ እነሆም፥ ለሌዊ ቤት የሆነች የአሮን በትር አቈጠቈጠች፥ ለመለመችም፥ አበባም አወጣች፥ የበሰለ ለውዝም አፈራች።

verses.en: And Mosheh brought out all the rods from before YAHUAH unto all the children of Yisra'el: and they looked, and took every man his rod.
verses.am: ሙሴም በትሮችን ሁሉ ከእግዚአብሔር ፊት ወደ እስራኤል ልጆች ሁሉ አወጣቸው፤ እነርሱም አዩ፥ እያንዳንዱም በትሩን ወሰደ።

verses.en: And YAHUAH said unto Mosheh, Bring Aaron's rod again before the testimony, to be kept for a token against the rebels; and thou shalt quite take away their murmurings from me, that they die not.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን። የአሮንን በትር ወደ ምስክሩ ፊት መልስ፤ ማጕረምረማቸው ከእኔ ዘንድ እንዲጠፋ እነርሱም እንዳይሞቱ ለሚያምፁብኝ ልጆች ምልክት ሆና ትጠበቅ አለው።

verses.en: And Mosheh did so: as YAHUAH commanded him, so did he.
verses.am: ሙሴም እንዲሁ አደረገ፤ እግዚአብሔር እንዳዘዘው እንዲሁ አደረገ።

verses.en: And the children of Yisra'el spake unto Mosheh, saying, Behold, we die, we perish, we all perish.
verses.am: የእስራኤልም ልጆች ሙሴን።እነሆ፥ እንሞታለን፥ እንጠፋለን፥ ሁላችንም እንጠፋለን።

verses.en: Whosoever cometh any thing near unto the tabernacle of YAHUAH shall die: shall we be consumed with dying?
verses.am: የሚቀርብ ሁሉ፥ ወደ እግዚአብሔር ማደሪያ የሚቀርብ፥ ይሞታል፤ በውኑ ሁላችን እንሞታለንን? ብለው ተናገሩት።

verses.en: And YAHUAH said unto Aaron, Thou and thy sons and thy father's house with thee shall bear the iniquity of the sanctuary: and thou and thy sons with thee shall bear the iniquity of your priesthood.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም አሮንን አለው። አንተ ከአንተም ጋር ልጆችህና የአባቶችህ ቤት የመቅደስን ኃጢአት ትሸከማላችሁ፤ አንተም ከአንተም ጋር ልጆችህ የክህነታችሁን ኃጢአት ትሸከማላችሁ።

verses.en: And thy brethren also of the tribe of Levi, the tribe of thy father, bring thou with thee, that they may be joined unto thee, and minister unto thee: but thou and thy sons with thee shall minister before the tabernacle of witness.
verses.am: ደግሞም የአባትህን የሌዊን ነገድ ወንድሞችህን ከአንተ ጋር አቅርብ፤ ከአንተም ጋር በአንድነት ይሁኑ፥ ያገልግሉህም፤ አንተ ግን ከአንተም ጋር ልጆችህ በምስክሩ ድንኳን ፊት ትሆናላችሁ።

verses.en: And they shall keep thy charge, and the charge of all the tabernacle: only they shall not come nigh the vessels of the sanctuary and the altar, that neither they, nor ye also, die.
verses.am: እነርሱም ትእዛዝህን የድንኳኑንም ሁሉ አገግሎት ይጠብቁ፤ ነገር ግን እንዳይሞቱ፥ እናንተም ደግሞ ከእነርሱ ጋር እንዳትሞቱ፥ እነርሱ ወደ መቅደሱ ዕቃና ወደ መሠዊያው አይቅረቡ።

verses.en: And they shall be joined unto thee, and keep the charge of the tabernacle of the congregation, for all the service of the tabernacle: and a stranger shall not come nigh unto you.
verses.am: ነገር ግን ከእናንተ ጋር በአንድነት ይሁኑ፥ ለድንኳኑም አገልግሎት ሁሉ የመገናኛውን ድንኳን ይጠብቁ፤ ሌላም ሰው ወደ እናንተ አይቅረብ።

verses.en: And ye shall keep the charge of the sanctuary, and the charge of the altar: that there be no wrath any more upon the children of Yisra'el.
verses.am: እንደ ገና በእስራኤል ልጆች ላይ ቍጣ እንዳይሆንባቸው እናንተ መቅደሱንና መሠዊያውን ጠብቁ።

verses.en: And I, behold, I have taken your brethren the Levites from among the children of Yisra'el: to you they are given as a gift for YAHUAH, to do the service of the tabernacle of the congregation.
verses.am: እኔም፥ እነሆ፥ ሌዋውያንን ወንድሞቻችሁን ከእስራኤል ልጆች መካከል ወስጄአለሁ፤ የመገናኛውን ድንኳን አገልግሎት ያደርጉ ዘንድ ለእግዚአብሔር የተሰጡ ለእናንተ ስጦታ ናቸው።

verses.en: Therefore thou and thy sons with thee shall keep your priest's office for every thing of the altar, and within the vail; and ye shall serve: I have given your priest's office unto you as a service of gift: and the stranger that cometh nigh shall be put to death.
verses.am: አንተም ከአንተም ጋር ልጆችህ ለመሠዊያው ሥራ የሚሆነውን ሁሉ፥ በመጋረጃውም ውስጥ የሚሆነውን ታደርጉ ዘንድ ክህነታችሁን ጠብቁ፥ አገልግሉም፤ ክህነቱን ለስጦታ አገልግሎት ሰጥቼአችኋለሁ፤ ሌላም ሰው ቢቀርብ ይገደል።

verses.en: And YAHUAH spake unto Aaron, Behold, I also have given thee the charge of mine heave offerings of all the hallowed things of the children of Yisra'el; unto thee have I given them by reason of the anointing, and to thy sons, by an ordinance for ever.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም አሮንን ተናገረው እንዲህም አለው። እነሆ፥ የእስራኤል ልጆች ለእኔ የቀደሱትን የማንሣት ቍርባኔን ሁሉ ለአንተ ሰጥቼሃለሁ፤ ስለ መቀባትህ ለአንተና ለልጆችህ ድርሻ እንዲሆን ለዘላለም ሰጥቼሃለሁ።

verses.en: This shall be thine of the most holy things, reserved from the fire: every oblation of theirs, every meat offering of theirs, and every sin offering of theirs, and every trespass offering of theirs, which they shall render unto me, shall be most holy for thee and for thy sons.
verses.am: በእሳት ከሚቀርበው ከተቀደሰው ይህ ለአንተ ይሆናል፤ ለእኔ የሚያመጡት መባቸው ሁሉ፥ የእህሉ ቍርባናቸው ሁሉ፥ የኃጢአታቸውም መስዋዕት ሁሉ፥ የበደላቸውም መሥዋዕት ሁሉ፥ ለአንተ ለልጆችህም የተቀደሰ ይሆናል።

verses.en: In the most holy place shalt thou eat it; every male shall eat it: it shall be holy unto thee.
verses.am: በተቀደሰ ስፍራ ብላው፤ ወንዶች ሁሉ ይብሉት፤ የተቀደሰ ይሆንልሃል።

verses.en: And this is thine; the heave offering of their gift, with all the wave offerings of the children of Yisra'el: I have given them unto thee, and to thy sons and to thy daughters with thee, by a statute for ever: every one that is clean in thy house shall eat of it.
verses.am: ይህም ለአንተ ነው፤ የእስራኤል ልጆች ለስጦታ ያቀረቡትን የማንሣትና የመወዝወዝ ቍርባን ሁሉ ለአንተ ከአንተም ጋር ለወንዶችና ለሴቶች ልጆችህ ድርሻ እንዲሆን ለዘላለም ሰጥቼሃለሁ፤ በቤትህ ውስጥ ንጹሕ የሆነ ሁሉ ይብላው።

verses.en: All the best of the oil, and all the best of the wine, and of the wheat, the firstfruits of them which they shall offer unto YAHUAH, them have I given thee.
verses.am: ለእግዚአብሔር ከሚሰጡት የፍሬ መጀመሪያ ከዘይትና ከወይን ከእህልም የተመረጠውን ሁሉ ለአንተ ሰጥቼሃለሁ።

verses.en: And whatsoever is first ripe in the land, which they shall bring unto YAHUAH, shall be thine; every one that is clean in thine house shall eat of it.
verses.am: ወደ እግዚአብሔር የሚያመጡት በምድራቸው ያለው ሁሉ የፍሬ መጀመሪያ ለአንተ ይሆናል፤ በቤትህ ውስጥ ንጹሕ የሆነ ሁሉ ይብላው።

verses.en: Every thing devoted in Yisra'el shall be thine.
verses.am: በእስራኤል ዘንድ እርም የሆነው ሁሉ ለአንተ ይሆናል።

verses.en: Every thing that openeth the matrix in all flesh, which they bring unto YAHUAH, whether it be of men or beasts, shall be thine: nevertheless the firstborn of man shalt thou surely redeem, and the firstling of unclean beasts shalt thou redeem.
verses.am: ከሰው ወይም ከእንስሳ ቢሆን፥ ለእግዚአብሔር ከሚያቀርቡት ሥጋ ሁሉ ማኅፀን የሚከፍት ሁሉ ለአንተ ይሆናል፤ ነገር ግን የሰውን በኵራት ፈጽሞ ትቤዠዋለህ፥ ያልነጻውንም እንስሳ በኵራት ትቤዠዋለህ።

verses.en: And those that are to be redeemed from a month old shalt thou redeem, according to thine estimation, for the money of five shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary, which is twenty gerahs.
verses.am: ከአንድ ወር ጀምሮ የምትቤዠውን እንደ ግምትህ ትቤዠዋለህ፤ ግምቱም እንደ መቅደሱ ሰቅል ሚዛን አምስት ሰቅል ይሆናል፤ እርሱም ሀያ አቦሊ ነው።

verses.en: But the firstling of a cow, or the firstling of a sheep, or the firstling of a goat, thou shalt not redeem; they are holy: thou shalt sprinkle their blood upon the altar, and shalt burn their fat for an offering made by fire, for a sweet savour unto YAHUAH.
verses.am: ነገር ግን የላም በኵራት ወይም የበግ በኵራት ወይም የፍየል በኵራት አትቤዥም፤ የተቀደሱ ናቸው፤ ደማቸውን በመሠዊያው ላይ ትረጨዋለህ፥ ስባቸውንም ለእግዚአብሔር ጣፋጭ ሽታ እንዲሆን ለእሳት ቍርባን ታቃጥለዋለህ።

verses.en: And the flesh of them shall be thine, as the wave breast and as the right shoulder are thine.
verses.am: ሥጋቸውም ለአንተ ይሆናል፤ እንደ መወዝወዝ ፍርምባ እንደ ቀኙም ወርች ለአንተ ይሆናል።

verses.en: All the heave offerings of the holy things, which the children of Yisra'el offer unto YAHUAH, have I given thee, and thy sons and thy daughters with thee, by a statute for ever: it is a covenant of salt for ever before YAHUAH unto thee and to thy seed with thee.
verses.am: የእስራኤል ልጆች ከተቀደሰው ነገር ሁሉ አንሥተው ለእግዚአብሔር ያቀረቡትን ለአንተ ከአንተም ጋር ለወንዶችና ለሴቶች ልጆችህ ድርሻ እንዲሆን ለዘላለም ሰጥቼሃለሁ፤ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ለአንተ ከአንተም ጋር ለዘርህ የጨው ቃል ኪዳን ለዘላለም ነው።

verses.en: And YAHUAH spake unto Aaron, Thou shalt have no inheritance in their land, neither shalt thou have any part among them: I am thy part and thine inheritance among the children of Yisra'el.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም አሮንን አለው። በምድራቸው ርስት በመካከላቸውም ድርሻ አይሆንልህም፤ በእስራኤል ልጆች መካከል ድርሻህና ርስትህ እኔ ነኝ።

verses.en: And, behold, I have given the children of Levi all the tenth in Yisra'el for an inheritance, for their service which they serve, even the service of the tabernacle of the congregation.
verses.am: ለሌዊም ልጆች፥ እነሆ፥ በመገናኛው ድንኳን አገልግሎት ስለሚያገለግሉ፥ የእስራኤልን ልጆች አሥራት ርስት አድርጌ ሰጥቼአለሁ።

verses.en: Neither must the children of Yisra'el henceforth come nigh the tabernacle of the congregation, lest they bear sin, and die.
verses.am: ከዚህም በኋላ ኃጢአትን እንዳይሸከሙ እንዳይሞቱም፥ የእስራኤል ልጆች ወደ መገናኛው ድንኳን አይቅረቡ።

verses.en: But the Levites shall do the service of the tabernacle of the congregation, and they shall bear their iniquity: it shall be a statute for ever throughout your generations, that among the children of Yisra'el they have no inheritance.
verses.am: ሌዋውያን ግን የመገናኛውን ድንኳን አገልግሎት ይሥሩ፥ እነርሱም ኃጢአታቸውን ይሸከማሉ፤ ለልጅ ልጃችሁ ለዘላለም ሥርዓት ይሆናል፤ በእስራኤልም ልጆች መካከል ርስት አይወርሱም።

verses.en: But the tithes of the children of Yisra'el, which they offer as an heave offering unto YAHUAH, I have given to the Levites to inherit: therefore I have said unto them, Among the children of Yisra'el they shall have no inheritance.
verses.am: ለእግዚአብሔር የማንሣት ቍርባን የሚያቀርቡትን የእስራኤልን ልጆች አሥራት ለሌዋውያን ርስት አድርጌ ሰጥቼአለሁ፤ ስለዚህ። በእስራኤል ልጆች መካከል ርስት አይወርሱም አልኋቸው።

verses.en: And YAHUAH spake unto Mosheh, saying,
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን እንዲህ ብሎ ተናገረው።

verses.en: Thus speak unto the Levites, and say unto them, When ye take of the children of Yisra'el the tithes which I have given you from them for your inheritance, then ye shall offer up an heave offering of it for YAHUAH, even a tenth part of the tithe.
verses.am: ለሌዋውያን እንዲህ ብለህ ንገራቸው። ከእስራኤል ልጆች ለእናንተ ርስት አድርጌ የሰጠኋችሁን አሥራት በተቀበላችሁ ጊዜ፥ ለእግዚአብሔር ለማንሣት ቍርባን የአሥራት አሥራት ታቀርባላችሁ።

verses.en: And this your heave offering shall be reckoned unto you, as though it were the corn of the threshingfloor, and as the fulness of the winepress.
verses.am: የማንሣት ቍርባናችሁም እንደ አውድማው እህልና እንደ ወይን መጭመቂያው ፍሬ ይቈጠርላችኋል።

verses.en: Thus ye also shall offer an heave offering unto YAHUAH of all your tithes, which ye receive of the children of Yisra'el; and ye shall give thereof YAHUAH's heave offering to Aaron the priest.
verses.am: እንዲሁ እናንተ ደግሞ ከእስራኤል ልጆች ከምትቀበሉት አሥራት ሁሉ ለእግዚአብሔር የማንሣት ቍርባን ታቀርባላችሁ፤ የእግዚአብሔርንም የማንሣት ቍርባን ለካህኑ ለአሮን ትሰጣላችሁ።

verses.en: Out of all your gifts ye shall offer every heave offering of YAHUAH, of all the best thereof, even the hallowed part thereof out of it.
verses.am: ከምትቀበሉት ስጦታ ሁሉ፥ ከተመረጠው ከተቀደሰውም ድርሻ ሁሉ፥ የእግዚአብሔርን የማንሣት ቍርባን ሁሉ ታቀርባላችሁ።

verses.en: Therefore thou shalt say unto them, When ye have heaved the best thereof from it, then it shall be counted unto the Levites as the increase of the threshingfloor, and as the increase of the winepress.
verses.am: ስለዚህ ትላቸዋለህ። ከእርሱ የተመረጠውን ባነሣችሁ ጊዜ እንደ አውድማው እህልና እንደ ወይን መጭመቂያው ፍሬ ለሌዋውያን ይቈጠራል።

verses.en: And ye shall eat it in every place, ye and your households: for it is your reward for your service in the tabernacle of the congregation.
verses.am: እናንተም ቤተ ሰቦቻችሁም፥ በመገናኛው ድንኳን ውስጥ የማገልገላችሁ ዋጋ ነውና በሁሉ ስፍራ ትበሉታላችሁ።

verses.en: And ye shall bear no sin by reason of it, when ye have heaved from it the best of it: neither shall ye pollute the holy things of the children of Yisra'el, lest ye die.
verses.am: የተመረጠውንም ከእርሱ ባነሣችሁ ጊዜ ስለ እርሱ ኃጢአትን አትሸከሙም፤ እንዳትሞቱም የእስራኤል ልጆች የቀደሱትን አታረክሱም።

verses.en: And YAHUAH spake unto Mosheh and unto Aaron, saying,
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴንና አሮንን እንዲህ ብሎ ተናገራቸው።

verses.en: This is the ordinance of the law which YAHUAH hath commanded, saying, Speak unto the children of Yisra'el, that they bring thee a red heifer without spot, wherein is no blemish, and upon which never came yoke:
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ያዘዘው የሕጉ ትእዛዝ ይህ ነው፤ መልካሚቱን፥ ነውርም የሌለባትን፥ ቀንበርም ያልተጫነባትን ቀይ ጊደር ያመጡልህ ዘንድ ለእስራኤል ልጆች ንገራቸው።

verses.en: And ye shall give her unto Eleazar the priest, that he may bring her forth without the camp, and one shall slay her before his face:
verses.am: እርስዋንም ለካህኑ ለአልዓዛር ትሰጣላችሁ፥ እርስዋንም ከሰፈር ወደ ውጭ ይወስዳታል፥ አንድ ሰውም በፊቱ ያርዳታል።

verses.en: And Eleazar the priest shall take of her blood with his finger, and sprinkle of her blood directly before the tabernacle of the congregation seven times:
verses.am: ካህኑም አልዓዛር ከደምዋ በጣቱ ይወስዳል፥ ከደምዋም ወደ መገናኛው ድንኳን ፊት ሰባት ጊዜ ይረጫል።

verses.en: And one shall burn the heifer in his sight; her skin, and her flesh, and her blood, with her dung, shall he burn:
verses.am: ጊደሪቱም በፊቱ ትቃጠላለች፤ ቁርበትዋም ሥጋዋም ደምዋም ፈርስዋም ይቃጠላል።

verses.en: And the priest shall take cedar wood, and hyssop, and scarlet, and cast it into the midst of the burning of the heifer.
verses.am: ካህኑም የዝግባ እንጨት ሂሶጵም ቀይ ግምጃም ወስዶ ጊደሪቱ በምትቃጠልበት እሳት መካከል ይጥለዋል።

verses.en: Then the priest shall wash his clothes, and he shall bathe his flesh in water, and afterward he shall come into the camp, and the priest shall be unclean until the even.
verses.am: ካህኑም ልብሱን ያጥባል፥ ገላውንም በውኃ ይታጠባል፥ ከዚያም በኋላ ወደ ሰፈሩ ይገባል፤ ካህኑም እስከ ማታ ርኩስ ይሆናል።

verses.en: And he that burneth her shall wash his clothes in water, and bathe his flesh in water, and shall be unclean until the even.
verses.am: ያቃጠላትም ሰው ልብሱን በውኃ ያጥባል፥ ገላውንም በውኃ ይታጠባል፥ እስከ ማታም ድረስ ርኩስ ይሆናል።

verses.en: And a man that is clean shall gather up the ashes of the heifer, and lay them up without the camp in a clean place, and it shall be kept for the congregation of the children of Yisra'el for a water of separation: it is a purification for sin.
verses.am: ንጹሕም ሰው የጊደሪቱን አመድ ያከማቻል ከሰፈሩም ውጭ በንጹሕ ስፍራ ያኖረዋል፤ ርኵሰትም ለሚያነጻ ውኃ ለእስራኤል ልጆች ማኅበር ይጠበቃል፤ ከኃጢአት ለማንጻት የሚሆን ነው።

verses.en: And he that gathereth the ashes of the heifer shall wash his clothes, and be unclean until the even: and it shall be unto the children of Yisra'el, and unto the stranger that sojourneth among them, for a statute for ever.
verses.am: የጊደሪቱንም አመድ ያከማቸ ሰው ልብሱን ያጥባል እስከ ማታም ድረስ ርኩስ ይሆናል፤ ይህም ለእስራኤል ልጆች በመካከላቸውም ለሚኖር መጻተኛ ለዘላለም ሥርዓት ይሆናል።

verses.en: He that toucheth the dead body of any man shall be unclean seven days.
verses.am: የሞተውን ሰው በድን የሚነካ ሰባት ቀን ርኵስ ይሆናል፤

verses.en: He shall purify himself with it on the third day, and on the seventh day he shall be clean: but if he purify not himself the third day, then the seventh day he shall not be clean.
verses.am: በዚህም ውኃ በሦስተኛውና በሰባተኛው ቀን ሁለመናውን ያጠራል፥ ንጹሕም ይሆናል፤ ነገር ግን በሦስተኛውና በሰባተኛው ቀን ሁለመናውን ባያጠራ ንጹሕ አይሆንም።

verses.en: Whosoever toucheth the dead body of any man that is dead, and purifieth not himself, defileth the tabernacle of YAHUAH; and that soul shall be cut off from Yisra'el: because the water of separation was not sprinkled upon him, he shall be unclean; his uncleanness is yet upon him.
verses.am: የሞተውን ሰው በድን የነካ ሁለመናውን ባያጠራ የእግዚአብሔርን ማደሪያ ያረክሳል፤ ያ ሰው ከእስራኤል ዘንድ ተለይቶ ይጠፋል፤ በእርሱም ላይ የሚያነጻ ውኃ አልተረጨምና ርኩስ ይሆናል፤ ርኵሰቱ ገና በእርሱ ላይ ነው።

verses.en: This is the law, when a man dieth in a tent: all that come into the tent, and all that is in the tent, shall be unclean seven days.
verses.am: ሰው በድንኳን ውስጥ ቢሞት ሕጉ ይህ ነው፤ ወደ ድንኳኑ የሚገባ ሁሉ በድንኳኑም ውስጥ ያለው ሁሉ ሰባት ቀን ርኵስ ይሆናል።

verses.en: And every open vessel, which hath no covering bound upon it, is unclean.
verses.am: መክደኛው ያልታሰረ የተከፈተ ዕቃ ሁሉ ርኩስ ነው።

verses.en: And whosoever toucheth one that is slain with a sword in the open fields, or a dead body, or a bone of a man, or a grave, shall be unclean seven days.
verses.am: በሜዳም በሰይፍ የተገደለውን ወይም የሞተውን በድን ወይም የሰውን አጥንት ወይም መቃብር የሚነካ ሰባት ቀን ርኩስ ይሆናል።

verses.en: And for an unclean person they shall take of the ashes of the burnt heifer of purification for sin, and running water shall be put thereto in a vessel:
verses.am: ከኃጢአት ለማንጻት እንድትሆን ከተቃጠለችው ጊደር አመድ ለርኩሱ ይወስዱለታል፥ በዕቃውም ውስጥ የምንጭ ውኃ ይቀላቀልበታል።

verses.en: And a clean person shall take hyssop, and dip it in the water, and sprinkle it upon the tent, and upon all the vessels, and upon the persons that were there, and upon him that touched a bone, or one slain, or one dead, or a grave:
verses.am: ንጹሕም ሰው ሂሶጱን ወስዶ በውኃው ውስጥ ያጠልቀዋል፤ በድንኳኑም፥ በዕቃውም ሁሉ፥ በዚያም ባሉ ሰዎች ላይ፥ አጥንቱንም ወይም የተገደለውን ወይም የሞተውን ወይም መቃብሩን በነካው ላይ ይረጨዋል፤

verses.en: And the clean person shall sprinkle upon the unclean on the third day, and on the seventh day: and on the seventh day he shall purify himself, and wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and shall be clean at even.
verses.am: ንጹሑም በሦስተኛውና በሰባተኛው ቀን በርኩሱ ላይ ይረጨዋል፤ ባሰባተኛውም ቀን ያጠራዋል፤ እርሱም ልብሱን ያጥባል፥ ገላውንም በውኃ ይታጠባል፥ በማታም ጊዜ ንጹሕ ይሆናል።

verses.en: But the man that shall be unclean, and shall not purify himself, that soul shall be cut off from among the congregation, because he hath defiled the sanctuary of YAHUAH: the water of separation hath not been sprinkled upon him; he is unclean.
verses.am: ሰውም ርኩስ ቢሆን ሁለመናውንም ባያጠራ፥ ያ ሰው የእግዚአብሔርን መቅደስ አርክሶአልና ከጉባኤው መካከል ተለይቶ ይጠፋል፤ በሚያነጻ ውኃ አልተረጨም፤ ርኩስ ነው።

verses.en: And it shall be a perpetual statute unto them, that he that sprinkleth the water of separation shall wash his clothes; and he that toucheth the water of separation shall be unclean until even.
verses.am: ይህም የዘላለም ሥርዓት ይሆንላችኋል፤ የሚያነጻውን ውኃ የሚረጭ ሰው ልብሱን ያጥባል፤ የሚያነጻውንም ውኃ የሚነካ እስከ ማታ ድረስ ርኩስ ይሆናል።

verses.en: And whatsoever the unclean person toucheth shall be unclean; and the soul that toucheth it shall be unclean until even.
verses.am: ርኩሱም የሚነካው ነገር ሁሉ ርኩስ ይሆናል፤ የሚነካውም ሰው እስከ ማታ ድረስ ርኩስ ይሆናል።

verses.en: Then came the children of Yisra'el, even the whole congregation, into the desert of Zin in the first month: and the people abode in Kadesh; and Miriam died there, and was buried there.
verses.am: የእስራኤልም ልጆች ማኅበር ሁሉ በመጀመሪያው ወር ወደ ጺን ምድረ በዳ መጡ፤ ሕዝቡም በቃዴስ ተቀመጡ፤ ማርያምም በዚያ ሞተች፥ በዚያም ተቀበረች።

verses.en: And there was no water for the congregation: and they gathered themselves together against Mosheh and against Aaron.
verses.am: ለማኅበሩም ውኃ አልነበረም፤ በሙሴና በአሮንም ላይ ተሰበሰቡ።

verses.en: And the people chode with Mosheh, and spake, saying, Would YAHUAH that we had died when our brethren died before YAHUAH!
verses.am: ሕዝቡም ሙሴን ተጣሉት፥ እንዲህም ብለው ተናገሩት። ወንድሞቻችን በእግዚአብሔር ፊት በሞቱ ጊዜ እኛም ምነው በሞትን ኖሮ!

verses.en: And why have ye brought up the congregation of YAHUAH into this wilderness, that we and our cattle should die there?
verses.am: እኛ ከብቶቻችንም በዚያ እንሞት ዘንድ የእግዚአብሔርን ጉባኤ ወደዚህ ምድረ በዳ ለምን አመጣችሁ?

verses.en: And wherefore have ye made us to come up out of Mitsrayim, to bring us in unto this evil place? it is no place of seed, or of figs, or of vines, or of pomegranates; neither is there any water to drink.
verses.am: ወደዚህ ክፉ ስፍራ ታመጡን ዘንድ ከግብፅ ለምን አወጣችሁን? ዘርና በለስ ወይንም ሮማንም የሌለበት ስፍራ ነው፤ የሚጠጣም ውኃ የለበትም።

verses.en: And Mosheh and Aaron went from the presence of the assembly unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, and they fell upon their faces: and the glory of YAHUAH appeared unto them.
verses.am: ሙሴና አሮንም ከጉባኤው ፊት ወደ መገናኛው ድንኳን ደጃፍ ሂደው በግምባራቸው ወደቁ፤ የእግዚአብሔርም ክብር ተገለጠላቸው።

verses.en: And YAHUAH spake unto Mosheh, saying,
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን እንዲህ ብሎ ተናገረው።

verses.en: Take the rod, and gather thou the assembly together, thou, and Aaron thy brother, and speak ye unto the rock before their eyes; and it shall give forth his water, and thou shalt bring forth to them water out of the rock: so thou shalt give the congregation and their beasts drink.
verses.am: በትርህን ውሰድ፤ አንተና ወንድምህ አሮን ማኅበሩን ሰብስቡ፥ ድንጋዩም ውኃን እንዲሰጥ እነርሱ ሲያዩ ተናገሩት፤ ከድንጋዩም ውኃ ታወጣላቸዋለህ፤ እንዲሁም ማኅበሩን ከብቶቻቸውንም ታጠጣላቸዋለህ።

verses.en: And Mosheh took the rod from before YAHUAH, as he commanded him.
verses.am: ሙሴም እንደ ታዘዘ በትሩን ከእግዚአብሔር ፊት ወሰደ።

verses.en: And Mosheh and Aaron gathered the congregation together before the rock, and he said unto them, Hear now, ye rebels; must we fetch you water out of this rock?
verses.am: ሙሴና አሮንም ጉባኤውን በድንጋዩ ፊት ሰብስበው። እናንተ ዓመፀኞች፥ እንግዲህ ስሙ፤ በውኑ ከዚህ ድንጋይ ውኃን እናወጣላችኋለን? አላቸው።

verses.en: And Mosheh lifted up his hand, and with his rod he smote the rock twice: and the water came out abundantly, and the congregation drank, and their beasts also.
verses.am: ሙሴም እጁን ዘርግቶ ድንጋዩን ሁለት ጊዜ በበትሩ መታው፤ ብዙም ውኃ ወጣ፥ ማኅበሩም ከብቶቻቸውም ጠጡ።

verses.en: And YAHUAH spake unto Mosheh and Aaron, Because ye believed me not, to sanctify me in the eyes of the children of Yisra'el, therefore ye shall not bring this congregation into the land which I have given them.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴንና አሮንን። በእስራኤል ልጆች ፊት ትቀድሱኝ ዘንድ በእኔ አላመናችሁምና ስለዚህ ወደ ሰጠኋቸው ምድር ይህን ጉባኤ ይዛችሁ አትገቡም አላቸው።

verses.en: This is the water of Meribah; because the children of Yisra'el strove with YAHUAH, and he was sanctified in them.
verses.am: የእስራኤል ልጆች በእግዚአብሔር ላይ ጠብ ያደረጉበት፥ እርሱም ቅዱስ መሆኑን የገለጠበት ይህ የመሪባ ውኃ ነው።

verses.en: And Mosheh sent messengers from Kadesh unto the king of Edom, Thus saith thy brother Yisra'el, Thou knowest all the travail that hath befallen us:
verses.am: ሙሴም ከቃዴስ ወደ ኤዶምያስ ንጉሥ መልእክተኞችን እንዲህ ብሎ ላከ። ወንድምህ እስራኤል እንዲህ ይላል። ያገኘንን መከራ ሁሉ አንተ ታውቃለህ፤

verses.en: How our fathers went down into Mitsrayim, and we have dwelt in Mitsrayim a long time; and the Mitsrim vexed us, and our fathers:
verses.am: አባቶቻችን ወደ ግብፅ ወረዱ፥ በግብፅም እጅግ ዘመን ተቀመጥን ግብፃውያንም እኛንና አባቶቻችንን በደሉ፤

verses.en: And when we cried unto YAHUAH, he heard our voice, and sent an angel, and hath brought us forth out of Mitsrayim: and, behold, we are in Kadesh, a city in the uttermost of thy border:
verses.am: ወደ እግዚአብሔርም በጮኽን ጊዜ ድምፃችንን ሰማ፥ መልአክንም ሰድዶ ከግብፅ አወጣን፤ እነሆም፥ በምድርህ ዳርቻ ባለችው ከተማ በቃዴስ ተቀምጠናል።

verses.en: Let us pass, I pray thee, through thy country: we will not pass through the fields, or through the vineyards, neither will we drink of the water of the wells: we will go by the king's high way, we will not turn to the right hand nor to the left, until we have passed thy borders.
verses.am: እባክህ፥ በምድርህ ላይ እንለፍ፤ ወደ እርሻም ወደ ወይንም አንገባም፥ ከጕድጓዶችም ውኃን አንጠጣም፤ በንጉሡ ጐዳና እንሄዳለን፥ ዳርቻህንም እስክናልፍ ድረስ ወደ ቀኝም ወደ ግራም አንልም።

verses.en: And Edom said unto him, Thou shalt not pass by me, lest I come out against thee with the sword.
verses.am: ኤዶምያስም። በሰይፍ እንዳልገጥምህ በምድሬ ላይ አታልፍም አለው።

verses.en: And the children of Yisra'el said unto him, We will go by the high way: and if I and my cattle drink of thy water, then I will pay for it: I will only, without doing any thing else, go through on my feet.
verses.am: የእስራኤልም ልጆች። በጐዳናው እንሄዳለን፥ እኔም ከብቶቼም ከውኃህ ብንጠጣ ዋጋውን እንከፍላለን፥ ሌላም ምንም አናደርግም፤ ብቻ በእግራችን እንለፍ አሉት።

verses.en: And he said, Thou shalt not go through. And Edom came out against him with much people, and with a strong hand.
verses.am: እርሱም። አታልፍም አለ። ኤዶምያስም በብዙ ሕዝብና በጽኑ እጅ ሊገጥመው ወጣ።

verses.en: Thus Edom refused to give Yisra'el passage through his border: wherefore Yisra'el turned away from him.
verses.am: ኤዶምያስም እስራኤል በዳርቻው እንዳያልፍ ከለከለ፤ ስለዚህ እስራኤል ከእርሱ ተመለሰ።

verses.en: And the children of Yisra'el, even the whole congregation, journeyed from Kadesh, and came unto mount Hor.
verses.am: ከቃዴስም ተጓዙ፤ የእስራኤልም ልጆች ማኅበር ሁሉ ወደ ሖር ተራራ መጡ።

verses.en: And YAHUAH spake unto Mosheh and Aaron in mount Hor, by the coast of the land of Edom, saying,
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴንና አሮንን በኤዶምያስ ምድር ዳርቻ ባለው በሖር ተራራ እንዲህ ብሎ ተናገራቸው።

verses.en: Aaron shall be gathered unto his people: for he shall not enter into the land which I have given unto the children of Yisra'el, because ye rebelled against my word at the water of Meribah.
verses.am: አሮን ወደ ወገኑ ይከማች፤ በመሪባ ውኃ ዘንድ በቃሌ ላይ ስለ ዐመፃችሁ ለእስራኤል ልጆች ወደ ሰጠኋት ምድር አይገባም።

verses.en: Take Aaron and Eleazar his son, and bring them up unto mount Hor:
verses.am: አሮንና ልጁን አልዓዛርን ይዘህ ወደ ሖር ተራራ ላይ አምጣቸው፤

verses.en: And strip Aaron of his garments, and put them upon Eleazar his son: and Aaron shall be gathered unto his people, and shall die there.
verses.am: ከአሮንም ልብሱን አውጣ፥ ልጁንም አልዓዛርን አልብሰው፤ አሮንም ወደ ወገኑ ይከማች፥ በዚያም ይሙት።

verses.en: And Mosheh did as YAHUAH commanded: and they went up into mount Hor in the sight of all the congregation.
verses.am: ሙሴም እግዚአብሔር እንዳዘዘ አደረገ፤ ማኅበሩም ሁሉ እያዩ ወደ ሖር ተራራ ወጡ።

verses.en: And Mosheh stripped Aaron of his garments, and put them upon Eleazar his son; and Aaron died there in the top of the mount: and Mosheh and Eleazar came down from the mount.
