verses.am: የእህል ቍርባናቸውና የመጠጥ ቍርባናቸው ለወይፈኑ ለአውራውም በግ ለጠቦቶቹም እንደ ቍጥራቸው መጠን እንደ ሕጉ ይሆናሉ።

verses.en: And one goat for a sin offering; beside the continual burnt offering, and his meat offering, and his drink offering.
verses.am: ለኃጢአትም መሥዋዕት አንድ አውራ ፍየል ታቀርባላችሁ፤ በዘወትር ከሚቃጠለው መሥዋዕትና ከእህሉ ቍርባን ከመጠጡም ቍርባን ሌላ የሚቀርቡ ናቸው።

verses.en: These things ye shall do unto YAHUAH in your set feasts, beside your vows, and your freewill offerings, for your burnt offerings, and for your meat offerings, and for your drink offerings, and for your peace offerings.
verses.am: እነዚህንም፥ ከስእለታችሁና በፈቃዳችሁ ከምታመጡት ሌላ፥ ለሚቃጠል መሥዋዕት፥ ለእህልም ለመጠጥም ቍርባን፥ ለደኅንነትም መሥዋዕታችሁ በበዓላችሁ ጊዜ ለእግዚአብሔር አቅርቡ።

verses.en: And Mosheh told the children of Yisra'el according to all that YAHUAH commanded Mosheh.
verses.am: ሙሴም ለእስራኤል ልጆች እግዚአብሔር ሙሴን ያዘዘውን ሁሉ ነገራቸው።

verses.en: And Mosheh spake unto the heads of the tribes concerning the children of Yisra'el, saying, This is the thing which YAHUAH hath commanded.
verses.am: ሙሴም ለእስራኤል ልጆች ነገዶች አለቆች እንዲህ ብሎ ተናገራቸው። እግዚአብሔር ያዘዘው ነገር ይህ ነው።

verses.en: If a man vow a vow unto YAHUAH, or swear an oath to bind his soul with a bond; he shall not break his word, he shall do according to all that proceedeth out of his mouth.
verses.am: ሰው ለእግዚአብሔር ስእለት ቢሳል፥ ወይም ራሱ በመሐላ ቢያስር፥ ቃሉን አይስበር፤ ከአፉ እንደ ወጣው ሁሉ ያድርግ።

verses.en: If a woman also vow a vow unto YAHUAH, and bind herself by a bond, being in her father's house in her youth;
verses.am: ሴትም ደግሞ ለእግዚአብሔር ስእለት ብትሳል፥ እርስዋም በአባትዋ ቤት ሳለች በብላቴንነትዋ ጊዜ ራስዋን በመሐላ ብታስር፥

verses.en: And her father hear her vow, and her bond wherewith she hath bound her soul, and her father shall hold his peace at her: then all her vows shall stand, and every bond wherewith she hath bound her soul shall stand.
verses.am: አባትዋም ራስዋን ያሰረችበትን መሐላ ስእለትዋንም ቢሰማ፥ አባትዋም ዝም ቢላት፥ ስእለትዋ ሁሉ ይጸናል፥ ራስዋንም ያሰረችበት መሐላ ሁሉ ይጸናል።

verses.en: But if her father disallow her in the day that he heareth; not any of her vows, or of her bonds wherewith she hath bound her soul, shall stand: and YAHUAH shall forgive her, because her father disallowed her.
verses.am: አባትዋ ግን በሰማበት ቀን ቢከለክላት፥ ስእለትዋ ራስዋንም ያሰረችበት መሐላዋ አይጸኑም፤ አባትዋ ከልክሎአታልና እግዚአብሔር ይቅር ይላታል።

verses.en: And if she had at all an husband, when she vowed, or uttered ought out of her lips, wherewith she bound her soul;
verses.am: በተሳለችም ጊዜ ራስዋንም በመሐላ ያሰረችበት ነገር ከአፍዋ በወጣ ጊዜ ባል ያገባች ብትሆን፥

verses.en: And her husband heard it, and held his peace at her in the day that he heard it: then her vows shall stand, and her bonds wherewith she bound her soul shall stand.
verses.am: ባልዋም ቢሰማ፥ በሰማበትም ቀን ዝም ቢላት፥ ስእለትዋ ይጸናል፥ ራስዋንም ያሰረችበት መሐላ ይጸናል።

verses.en: But if her husband disallowed her on the day that he heard it; then he shall make her vow which she vowed, and that which she uttered with her lips, wherewith she bound her soul, of none effect: and YAHUAH shall forgive her.
verses.am: ባልዋ ግን በሰማበት ቀን ቢከለክላት፥ በእርስዋ ላይ ያለውን ስእለትዋን ራስዋንም በመሐላ ያሰረችበትን የአፍዋን ነገር ከንቱ ያደርገዋል፤ እግዚአብሔርም ይቅር ይላታል።

verses.en: But every vow of a widow, and of her that is divorced, wherewith they have bound their souls, shall stand against her.
verses.am: ባልዋ የሞተባት ወይም የተፋታች ግን ስእለትዋ ራስዋንም ያሰረችበት መሐላ ይጸኑባታል።

verses.en: And if she vowed in her husband's house, or bound her soul by a bond with an oath;
verses.am: ሴትም በባልዋ ቤት ሳለች ብትሳል፥ ወይም ራስዋን በመሐላ ብታስር፥

verses.en: And her husband heard it, and held his peace at her, and disallowed her not: then all her vows shall stand, and every bond wherewith she bound her soul shall stand.
verses.am: ባልዋም ሰምቶ ዝም ቢላት ባይከለክላትም፥ ስእለትዋ ሁሉ ራስዋንም ያሰረችበት መሐላ ሁሉ ይጸናል።

verses.en: But if her husband hath utterly made them void on the day he heard them; then whatsoever proceeded out of her lips concerning her vows, or concerning the bond of her soul, shall not stand: her husband hath made them void; and YAHUAH shall forgive her.
verses.am: ባልዋ ግን በሰማበት ቀን ከንቱ ቢያደርገው፥ ስለ ስእለትዋ ወይም ራስዋን ስላሰረችበት መሐላ ከአፍዋ የወጣው ነገር አይጸናም፤ ባልዋ ከንቱ አድርጎታል፤ እግዚአብሔርም ይቅር ይላታል።

verses.en: Every vow, and every binding oath to afflict the soul, her husband may establish it, or her husband may make it void.
verses.am: ስእለትዋን ሁሉ ነፍስዋንም የሚያዋርደውን መሐላ ሁሉ ባልዋ ያጸናዋል፥ ባልዋም ከንቱ ያደርገዋል።

verses.en: But if her husband altogether hold his peace at her from day to day; then he establisheth all her vows, or all her bonds, which are upon her: he confirmeth them, because he held his peace at her in the day that he heard them.
verses.am: ባልዋ ግን በየዕለቱ ዝም ቢላት፥ ስእለትዋን ሁሉ በእርስዋም ላይ ያለውን መሐላ ሁሉ አጽንቶታል፤ በሰማበት ቀን ዝም ብሎአታልና አጽንቶታል።

verses.en: But if he shall any ways make them void after that he hath heard them; then he shall bear her iniquity.
verses.am: ከሰማው በኋላ ግን ከንቱ ቢያደርገው ኃጢአትዋን ይሸከማል።

verses.en: These are the statutes, which YAHUAH commanded Mosheh, between a man and his wife, between the father and his daughter, being yet in her youth in her father's house.
verses.am: እርስዋ በብላቴንነትዋ ጊዜ በአባትዋ ቤት ሳለች በአባትና በልጂቱ መካከል፥ ወይም በባልና በሚስት መካከል ይሆን ዘንድ እግዚአብሔር ሙሴን ያዘዘው ሥርዓት ይህ ነው።

verses.en: And YAHUAH spake unto Mosheh, saying,
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን እንዲህ ብሎ ተናገረው።

verses.en: Avenge the children of Yisra'el of the Midianites: afterward shalt thou be gathered unto thy people.
verses.am: ስለ እስራኤል ልጆች በቀል ምድያማውያንን ተበቀል፤ ከዚያም በኋላ ወደ ወገኖችህ ትከማቻለህ።

verses.en: And Mosheh spake unto the people, saying, Arm some of yourselves unto the war, and let them go against the Midianites, and avenge YAHUAH of Midian.
verses.am: ሙሴም ሕዝቡን። ከእናንተ መካከል ሰዎች ለጦርነት ይሰለፉ፤ ስለ እግዚአብሔር በቀል ምድያምን ይበቀሉ ዘንድ በምድያም ላይ ይሂዱ፤

verses.en: Of every tribe a thousand, throughout all the tribes of Yisra'el, shall ye send to the war.
verses.am: ከእስራኤል ነገዶች ሁሉ ከየነገዱ አንድ ሺህ ሰው ወደ ጦርነት ስደዱ ብሎ ተናገራቸው።

verses.en: So there were delivered out of the thousands of Yisra'el, a thousand of every tribe, twelve thousand armed for war.
verses.am: ከእስራኤልም አእላፋት አሥራ ሁለት ሺህ፥ ከየነገዱ አንድ አንድ ሺህ፥ ለጦርነት የተሰለፉ ሰዎች ተሰጡ።

verses.en: And Mosheh sent them to the war, a thousand of every tribe, them and Phinehas the son of Eleazar the priest, to the war, with the holy instruments, and the trumpets to blow in his hand.
verses.am: ሙሴም ከየነገዱ አንድ አንድ ሺህ ወደ ጦርነት ሰደደ፤ እነርሱንና የካህኑን የአልዓዛርን ልጅ ፊንሐስን ወደ ጦርነት ሰደዳቸው፤ የመቅደሱንም ዕቃ የሚነፋውንም መለከት በእጁ ሰጠው።

verses.en: And they warred against the Midianites, as YAHUAH commanded Mosheh; and they slew all the males.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን እንዳዘዘ ከምድያም ጋር ተዋጉ፥ ወንዶችንም ሁሉ ገደሉ።

verses.en: And they slew the kings of Midian, beside the rest of them that were slain; namely, Evi, and Rekem, and Zur, and Hur, and Reba, five kings of Midian: Balaam also the son of Beor they slew with the sword.
verses.am: ከተገደሉትም ጋር የምድያምን ነገሥታት ገደሉአቸው፤ አምስቱም የምድያም ነገሥታት ኤዊ፥ ሮቆም፥ ሱር፥ ሑር፥ ሪባ ነበሩ፤ የቢዖርንም ልጅ በለዓምን ደግሞ በሰይፍ ገደሉት።

verses.en: And the children of Yisra'el took all the women of Midian captives, and their little ones, and took the spoil of all their cattle, and all their flocks, and all their goods.
verses.am: የእስራኤልም ልጆች የምድያምን ሴቶችና ልጆቻቸውን ማረኩ፤ እንስሶቻቸውንና መንጎቻቸውንም ዕቃቸውንም ሁሉ በዘበዙ።

verses.en: And they burnt all their cities wherein they dwelt, and all their goodly castles, with fire.
verses.am: የተቀመጡባቸውን ከተሞቻቸውን ሁሉ ሰፈሮቻቸውንም ሁሉ በእሳት አቃጠሉ።

verses.en: And they took all the spoil, and all the prey, both of men and of beasts.
verses.am: የሰውንና የእንስሳን ምርኮና ብዝበዛ ሁሉ ወሰዱ።

verses.en: And they brought the captives, and the prey, and the spoil, unto Mosheh, and Eleazar the priest, and unto the congregation of the children of Yisra'el, unto the camp at the plains of Moab, which are by Jordan near Jericho.
verses.am: የማረኩአቸውንም ሰዎች ምርኮውንና ብዝበዛውን ወደ ሙሴና ወደ ካህኑ ወደ አልዓዛር ወደ እስራኤልም ልጆች ማኅበር፥ በዮርዳኖስም አጠገብ በኢያሪኮ ፊት ለፊት በሞዓብ ሜዳ ወዳለው ሰፈር አመጡ።

verses.en: And Mosheh, and Eleazar the priest, and all the princes of the congregation, went forth to meet them without the camp.
verses.am: ሙሴና ካህኑ አልዓዛርም የማኅበሩም አለቆች ሁሉ ከሰፈሩ ወደ ውጭ ሊገናኙአቸው ወጡ።

verses.en: And Mosheh was wroth with the officers of the host, with the captains over thousands, and captains over hundreds, which came from the battle.
verses.am: ሙሴም ከዘመቻ በተመለሱት በጭፍራ አለቆች፥ በሻለቆችና በመቶ አለቆች ላይ ተቈጣ።

verses.en: And Mosheh said unto them, Have ye saved all the women alive?
verses.am: ሙሴም አላቸው። በውኑ ሴቶችን ሁሉ አዳናችኋቸውን?

verses.en: Behold, these caused the children of Yisra'el, through the counsel of Balaam, to commit trespass against YAHUAH in the matter of Peor, and there was a plague among the congregation of YAHUAH.
verses.am: እነሆ፥ እነዚህ በፌጎር ምክንያት በበለዓም ምክር እግዚአብሔርን ይበድሉ ዘንድ ለእስራኤል ልጆች ዕንቅፋት ሆኑ፤ ስለዚህም በእግዚአብሔር ማኅበር ላይ መቅሠፍት ሆነ።

verses.en: Now therefore kill every male among the little ones, and kill every woman that hath known man by lying with him.
verses.am: አሁን እንግዲህ ከልጆቹ ወንዱን ሁሉ ግደሉ፥ ወንድንም በመኝታ የሚያውቁትን ሴቶች ሁሉ ግደሉ።

verses.en: But all the women children, that have not known a man by lying with him, keep alive for yourselves.
verses.am: ወንድን የማያውቁትን ሴቶች ልጆችን ሁሉ ግን ለራሳችሁ አድኑአቸው።

verses.en: And do ye abide without the camp seven days: whosoever hath killed any person, and whosoever hath touched any slain, purify both yourselves and your captives on the third day, and on the seventh day.
verses.am: ከሰፈሩም ውጭ ሰባት ቀን ስፈሩ፤ ሰውን የገደለ ሁሉ የተገደለውንም የዳሰሰ ሁሉ፥ እናንተ የማረካችኋቸውም በሦስተኛውና በሰባተኛው ቀን ሰውነታችሁን ንጹሕ አድርጉ።

verses.en: And purify all your raiment, and all that is made of skins, and all work of goats' hair, and all things made of wood.
verses.am: ልብስንም፥ ከቁርበትም የተዘጋጀውን ሁሉ፥ ከፍየልም ጠጕር ከእንጨትም የተሠራውን ሁሉ ንጹሕ አድርጉ።

verses.en: And Eleazar the priest said unto the men of war which went to the battle, This is the ordinance of the law which YAHUAH commanded Mosheh;
verses.am: ካህኑም አልዓዛር ከሰልፍ የመጡትን ሰዎች አላቸው። እግዚአብሔር ሙሴን ያዘዘው የሕጉ ሥርዓት ይህ ነው፤

verses.en: Only the gold, and the silver, the brass, the iron, the tin, and the lead,
verses.am: ወርቁንና ብሩን፥ ናሱንም፥ ብረቱንም፥ ቆርቆሮውንም፥

verses.en: Every thing that may abide the fire, ye shall make it go through the fire, and it shall be clean: nevertheless it shall be purified with the water of separation: and all that abideth not the fire ye shall make go through the water.
verses.am: አረሩንም፥ በእሳት ለማለፍ የሚችለውን ሁሉ በእሳት ታሳልፉታላችሁ፥ ንጹሕም ይሆናል፤ ነገር ግን በማንጻት ውኃ ደግሞ ይጠራል። በእሳትም ለማለፍ የማይችለውን በውኃ ታሳልፉታላችሁ።

verses.en: And ye shall wash your clothes on the seventh day, and ye shall be clean, and afterward ye shall come into the camp.
verses.am: በሰባተኛውም ቀን ልብሳችሁን እጠቡ፥ ንጹሕም ትሆናላችሁ፤ ከዚያም በኋላ ወደ ሰፈሩ ትቀርባላችሁ።

verses.en: And YAHUAH spake unto Mosheh, saying,
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን እንዲህ ብሎ ተናገረው።

verses.en: Take the sum of the prey that was taken, both of man and of beast, thou, and Eleazar the priest, and the chief fathers of the congregation:
verses.am: አንተና ካህኑ አልዓዛር የማኅበሩም አባቶች አለቆች የተማረኩትን ሰውና እንስሳ ቍጠሩ።

verses.en: And divide the prey into two parts; between them that took the war upon them, who went out to battle, and between all the congregation:
verses.am: ምርኮውንም በተዋጉትና ወደ ሰፍል በወጡት፥ በማኅበሩም ሁሉ መካከል አስተካክለህ ክፈል።

verses.en: And levy a tribute unto YAHUAH of the men of war which went out to battle: one soul of five hundred, both of the persons, and of the beeves, and of the asses, and of the sheep:
verses.am: ከእነዚያም ከተዋጉት ወደ ሰልፍም ከወጡት ሰልፈኞች ዘንድ፥ ከሰዎችም ከበሬዎችም ከአህዮችም ከመንጎችም ከአምስት መቶ አንድ ለእግዚአብሔር ግብር አውጣ።

verses.en: Take it of their half, and give it unto Eleazar the priest, for an heave offering of YAHUAH.
verses.am: ከድርሻቸው ወስደህ ለእግዚአብሔር ለማንሣት ቍርባን ለካህኑ ለአልዓዛር ስጠው።

verses.en: And of the children of Yisra'el's half, thou shalt take one portion of fifty, of the persons, of the beeves, of the asses, and of the flocks, of all manner of beasts, and give them unto the Levites, which keep the charge of the tabernacle of YAHUAH.
verses.am: ከእስራኤልም ልጆች ድርሻ ከሰዎች ከበሬዎችም ከአህዮችም ከመንጎችም ከከብቶችም ሁሉ ከአምሳ አንድ ትወስዳለህ፥ የእግዚአብሔርንም ማደሪያ አገልግሎት ለሚጠብቁ ለሌዋውያን ትሰጣለህ።

verses.en: And Mosheh and Eleazar the priest did as YAHUAH commanded Mosheh.
verses.am: ሙሴና ካህኑ አልዓዛርም እግዚአብሔር ሙሴን እንዳዘዘው አደረጉ።

verses.en: And the booty, being the rest of the prey which the men of war had caught, was six hundred thousand and seventy thousand and five thousand sheep,
verses.am: ወደ ሰልፍ የወጡ ሰዎችም ከወሰዱት ብዝበዛ ያስቀሩት ምርኮ እንዲህ ሆነ፤ ስድስት መቶ ሰባ አምስት ሺህ በጎች፥

verses.en: And threescore and twelve thousand beeves,
verses.am: ወንድ ከማያውቁ ሴቶችም ሠላሳ ሁለት ሺህ ነፍስ።

verses.en: And threescore and one thousand asses,
verses.am: ወንድ ከማያውቁ ሴቶችም ሠላሳ ሁለት ሺህ ነፍስ።

verses.en: And thirty and two thousand persons in all, of women that had not known man by lying with him.
verses.am: በዘመቻም ለነበሩ ሰዎች ድርሻ የሆነ እኵሌታ ከበግ ሦስት መቶ ሠላሳ ሰባት ሺህ አምስት መቶ በጎች ነበረ፥

verses.en: And the half, which was the portion of them that went out to war, was in number three hundred thousand and seven and thirty thousand and five hundred sheep:
verses.am: ከበጎችም የእግዚአብሔር ግብር ስድስት መቶ ሰባ አምስት ነበረ።

verses.en: And YAHUAH's tribute of the sheep was six hundred and threescore and fifteen.
verses.am: በሬዎችም ሠላሳ ስድስት ሺህ አምስት መቶ ነበሩ፤ የእግዚአብሔርም ግብር ሰባ ሁለት ነበረ።

verses.en: And the beeves were thirty and six thousand; of which YAHUAH's tribute was threescore and twelve.
verses.am: አህዮቹም ሠላሳ ሺህ አምስት መቶ ነበሩ፤ የእግዚአብሔርም ግብር ስድሳ አንድ ነበረ።

verses.en: And the asses were thirty thousand and five hundred; of which YAHUAH's tribute was threescore and one.
verses.am: ሰዎቹም አሥራ ስድስት ሺህ ነበሩ፤ የእግዚአብሔርም ግብር ሠላሳ ሁለት ነበረ።

verses.en: And the persons were sixteen thousand; of which YAHUAH's tribute was thirty and two persons.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን እንዳዘዘው ሙሴ ለእግዚአብሔር ለማንሣት ቍርባን የሆነውን ግብር ለካህኑ ለአልዓዛር ሰጠው።

verses.en: And Mosheh gave the tribute, which was YAHUAH's heave offering, unto Eleazar the priest, as YAHUAH commanded Mosheh.
verses.am: ከእስራኤል ልጆች እኩሌታም፥ ወደ ሰልፍ ከወጡት ወንዶች ላይ ሙሴ የለየው፥

verses.en: And of the children of Yisra'el's half, which Mosheh divided from the men that warred,
verses.am: የማኅበሩ ድርሻ ሦስት መቶ ሠላሳ ሰባት ሺህ አምስት መቶ በጎች፥

verses.en: (Now the half that pertained unto the congregation was three hundred thousand and thirty thousand and seven thousand and five hundred sheep,
verses.am: ሠላሳ ስድስት ሺህ በሬዎች፥

verses.en: And thirty and six thousand beeves,
verses.am: ሠላሳ ሺህ አምስት መቶ አህዮች፥

verses.en: And thirty thousand asses and five hundred,
verses.am: አሥራ ስድስት ሺህ ሰዎች ነበሩ።

verses.en: And sixteen thousand persons;)
verses.am: ከእስራኤል ልጆች ድርሻ ሙሴ ከሰውና ከእንስሳ ከአምሳ አንድ ወሰደ፥ እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን እንዳዘዘው የእግዚአብሔርን ማደሪያ አገልግሎት ለሚጠብቁ ሌዋውያን ሰጠ።

verses.en: Even of the children of Yisra'el's half, Mosheh took one portion of fifty, both of man and of beast, and gave them unto the Levites, which kept the charge of the tabernacle of YAHUAH; as YAHUAH commanded Mosheh.
verses.am: በሠራዊት አእላፋት ላይ የተሾሙት አለቆች፥ ሻለቆችና የመቶ አለቆች፥ ወደ ሙሴ ቀረቡ፥

verses.en: And the officers which were over thousands of the host, the captains of thousands, and captains of hundreds, came near unto Mosheh:
verses.am: ሙሴንም። እኛ ባሪያዎችህ ወደ ሰልፍ የወጡትን ከእጃችን በታች ያሉትን ቈጠርን፥ ከእኛም አንድ አልጐደለም።

verses.en: And they said unto Mosheh, Thy servants have taken the sum of the men of war which are under our charge, and there lacketh not one man of us.
verses.am: ሰውም ሁሉ ካገኘው ከወርቅ ዕቃ፥ ከእግር አልቦም፥ ከአምባርም፥ ከቀለበትም፥ ከጕትቻም፥ ከድሪውም ለነፍሳችን በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ያስተሰርይልን ዘንድ ለእግዚአብሔር መባ አምጥተናል አሉት።

verses.en: We have therefore brought an oblation for YAHUAH, what every man hath gotten, of jewels of gold, chains, and bracelets, rings, earrings, and tablets, to make an atonement for our souls before YAHUAH.
verses.am: ሙሴና ካህኑ አልዓዛርም ወርቁንና በልዩ ልዩ የተሠራውን ዕቃ ሁሉ ከእጃቸው ተቀበሉ።

verses.en: And Mosheh and Eleazar the priest took the gold of them, even all wrought jewels.
verses.am: ሻለቆችም የመቶ አለቆችም ለእግዚአብሔር ለማንሣት ቍርባን ያቀረቡት ወርቅ ሁሉ አሥራ ስድስት ሺህ ሰባት መቶ አምሳ ሰቅል ነበረ።

verses.en: And all the gold of the offering that they offered up to YAHUAH, of the captains of thousands, and of the captains of hundreds, was sixteen thousand seven hundred and fifty shekels.
verses.am: ወደ ሰልፍ የወጡ ሰዎች ሁሉ ከምርኮአቸው ለራሳቸው ወሰዱ።

verses.en: (For the men of war had taken spoil, every man for himself.)
verses.am: ሙሴና ካህኑ አልዓዛርም ወርቁን ከሻለቆችና ከመቶ አለቆች ወስደው በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ለእስራኤል ልጆች መታሰቢያ ወደ መገናኛው ድንኳን አገቡት።

verses.en: And Mosheh and Eleazar the priest took the gold of the captains of thousands and of hundreds, and brought it into the tabernacle of the congregation, for a memorial for the children of Yisra'el before YAHUAH.
Now the children of Reuben and the children of Gad had a very great multitude of cattle: and when they saw the land of Jazer, and the land of Gilead, that, behold, the place was a place for cattle;
verses.am: የሮቤልና የጋድ ልጆችም እጅግ ብዙ እንስሶች ነበሩአቸው፤ እነሆም፥ የኢያዜር ምድርና የገለዓድ ምድር ለእንስሶች የተመቸ ስፍራ እንደ ነበረ ባዩ ጊዜ፥

verses.en: The children of Gad and the children of Reuben came and spake unto Mosheh, and to Eleazar the priest, and unto the princes of the congregation, saying,
verses.am: የጋድና የሮቤል ልጆች መጥተው ሙሴንና ካህኑን አልዓዛርን የማኅበሩንም አለቆች እንዲህ ብለው ተናገሩአቸው።

verses.en: Ataroth, and Dibon, and Jazer, and Nimrah, and Heshbon, and Elealeh, and Shebam, and Nebo, and Beon,
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር በእስራኤል ማኅበር ፊት የመታው ምድር፥ አጣሮት፥ ዲቦን፥ ኢያዜር፥ ነምራ፥ ሐሴቦን፥ ኤልያሊ፥ ሴባማ፥ ናባው፥ ባያን፥ ለእንስሶች የተመቸ ምድር ነው፤ ለእኛም ለባሪያዎችህ እንስሶች አሉን።

verses.en: Even the country which YAHUAH smote before the congregation of Yisra'el, is a land for cattle, and thy servants have cattle:
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር በእስራኤል ማኅበር ፊት የመታው ምድር፥ አጣሮት፥ ዲቦን፥ ኢያዜር፥ ነምራ፥ ሐሴቦን፥ ኤልያሊ፥ ሴባማ፥ ናባው፥ ባያን፥ ለእንስሶች የተመቸ ምድር ነው፤ ለእኛም ለባሪያዎችህ እንስሶች አሉን።

verses.en: Wherefore, said they, if we have found grace in thy sight, let this land be given unto thy servants for a possession, and bring us not over Jordan.
verses.am: እኛስ በአንተ ዘንድ ሞገስን አግኝተን እንደ ሆነ ይህን ምድር ለባሪያዎችህ ርስት አድርገህ ስጠን፤ ወደ ዮርዳኖስም ማዶ አታሻግረን።

verses.en: And Mosheh said unto the children of Gad and to the children of Reuben, Shall your brethren go to war, and shall ye sit here?
verses.am: ሙሴም ለጋድና ለሮቤል ልጆች አላቸው። ወንድሞቻችሁ ወደ ጦርነት ሲሄዱ እናንተ በዚህ ትቀመጣላችሁን?

verses.en: And wherefore discourage ye the heart of the children of Yisra'el from going over into the land which YAHUAH hath given them?
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ወደሚሰጣቸው ምድር እንዳይሻገሩ የእስራኤልን ልጆች ልብ ለምን ታደክማላችሁ?

verses.en: Thus did your fathers, when I sent them from Kadeshbarnea to see the land.
verses.am: ምድሪቱን ይሰልሉ ዘንድ ከቃዴስ በርኔ በሰደድኋቸው ጊዜ አባቶቻችሁ እንዲህ አደረጉ።

verses.en: For when they went up unto the valley of Eshcol, and saw the land, they discouraged the heart of the children of Yisra'el, that they should not go into the land which YAHUAH had given them.
verses.am: ወደ ኤሽኮልም ሸለቆ በሄዱ ጊዜ፥ ምድሪቱንም ባዩ ጊዜ፥ እግዚአብሔር ወደ ሰጣቸው ምድር እንዳይገቡ የእስራኤልን ልጆች ልብ አደከሙ።

verses.en: And YAHUAH's anger was kindled the same time, and he sware, saying,
verses.am: በዚያም ቀን የእግዚአብሔር ቍጣ ነደደ፥

verses.en: Surely none of the men that came up out of Mitsrayim, from twenty years old and upward, shall see the land which I sware unto Abraham, unto Yitschaq, and unto Ya'aqob; because they have not wholly followed me:
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔርም ቍጣ በእስራኤል ላይ ጸና፥ በእግዚአብሔርም ፊት ክፉ ያደረገ ትውልድ ሁሉ እስኪጠፋ ድረስ አርባ ዓመት በምድረ በዳ ውስጥ አቅበዘበዛቸው።

verses.en: Save Caleb the son of Jephunneh the Kenezite, and Yahoshua the son of Nun: for they have wholly followed YAHUAH.
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔርም ቍጣ በእስራኤል ላይ ጸና፥ በእግዚአብሔርም ፊት ክፉ ያደረገ ትውልድ ሁሉ እስኪጠፋ ድረስ አርባ ዓመት በምድረ በዳ ውስጥ አቅበዘበዛቸው።

verses.en: And YAHUAH's anger was kindled against Yisra'el, and he made them wander in the wilderness forty years, until all the generation, that had done evil in the sight of YAHUAH, was consumed.
verses.am: እነሆም፥ የእግዚአብሔርን መዓት በእስራኤል ላይ አብዝታችሁ ትጨምሩ ዘንድ እናንተ የኃጢአተኞች ትውልድ በአባቶቻችሁ ፋንታ ቆማችኋል።

verses.en: And, behold, ye are risen up in your fathers' stead, an increase of sinful men, to augment yet the fierce anger of YAHUAH toward Yisra'el.
verses.am: እርሱን ከመከተል ብትመለሱ እርሱ ሕዝቡን በምድረ በዳ ደግሞ ይተዋል፤ ይህንንም ሕዝብ ሁሉ ታጠፋላችሁ።

verses.en: For if ye turn away from after him, he will yet again leave them in the wilderness; and ye shall destroy all this people.
verses.am: ወደ እርሱም ቀርበው አሉት። በዚህ ለእንስሶቻችን በረቶች ለልጆቻችንም ከተሞች እንሠራለን፤

verses.en: And they came near unto him, and said, We will build sheepfolds here for our cattle, and cities for our little ones:
verses.am: እኛ ግን ለጦርነት ተዘጋጅተን ወደ ስፍራቸው እስክናገባቸው ድረስ በእስራኤል ልጆች ፊት እንሄዳለን፤ በዚህም ምድር ስላሉ ሰዎች ልጆቻችን በተመሸጉ ከተሞች ይቀመጣሉ።

verses.en: But we ourselves will go ready armed before the children of Yisra'el, until we have brought them unto their place: and our little ones shall dwell in the fenced cities because of the inhabitants of the land.
verses.am: የእስራኤል ልጆች ሁሉ ርስታቸውን እስኪወርሱ ድረስ ወደ ቤቶቻችን አንመለስም፤

verses.en: We will not return unto our houses, until the children of Yisra'el have inherited every man his inheritance.
verses.am: ከዮርዳኖስ ወዲህ ወደ ምሥራቅ ርስታችን ደርሶናልና እኛ ከዮርዳኖስ ማዶ ወደዚያ ከእነርሱ ጋር ርስት አንወርስም።

verses.en: For we will not inherit with them on yonder side Jordan, or forward; because our inheritance is fallen to us on this side Jordan eastward.
verses.am: ሙሴም አላቸው። ይህንስ ነገር ብታደርጉ፥ ተዘጋጅታችሁም በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ወደ ሰልፍ ብትሄዱ፥

verses.en: And Mosheh said unto them, If ye will do this thing, if ye will go armed before YAHUAH to war,
verses.am: እርሱም ጠላቶቹን ከፊቱ እስኪያሳድድ ድረስ ምድሪቱም በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ድል እስክትሆን ድረስ ከእናንተ ሰው ሁሉ ጋሻ ጦሩን ይዞ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ዮርዳኖስን ቢሻገር፥

verses.en: And will go all of you armed over Jordan before YAHUAH, until he hath driven out his enemies from before him,
verses.am: ከዚያ በኋላ ትመለሳላችሁ፥ በእግዚአብሔርም ፊት በእስራኤል ዘንድ ንጹሐን ትሆናላችሁ፤ ይህች ምድርም በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ርስት ትሆንላችኋለች።

verses.en: And the land be subdued before YAHUAH: then afterward ye shall return, and be guiltless before YAHUAH, and before Yisra'el; and this land shall be your possession before YAHUAH.
verses.am: እናንተ ግን እንዲህ ባታደርጉ፥ እነሆ፥ እግዚአብሔርን ትበድላላችሁ፤ ኃጢአታችሁም እንዲያገኛችሁ እወቁ።

verses.en: But if ye will not do so, behold, ye have sinned against YAHUAH: and be sure your sin will find you out.
verses.am: ለልጆቻችሁ ከተሞች፥ ለበጎቻችሁም በረቶች ሥሩ፤ ከአፋችሁም የወጣውን ነገር አድርጉ።

verses.en: Build you cities for your little ones, and folds for your sheep; and do that which hath proceeded out of your mouth.
verses.am: የጋድና የሮቤልም ልጆች ሙሴን እንዲህ ብለው ተናገሩት። እኛ ባሪያዎችህ ጌታችን እንዳዘዘ እናደርጋለን።

verses.en: And the children of Gad and the children of Reuben spake unto Mosheh, saying, Thy servants will do as my lord commandeth.
verses.am: ልጆቻችን፥ ሚስቶቻችንም፥ መንጎቻችንም፥ እንስሶቻችንም ሁሉ በዚያ በገለዓድ ከተሞች ይሆናሉ፤

verses.en: Our little ones, our wives, our flocks, and all our cattle, shall be there in the cities of Gilead:
verses.am: እኛ ባሪያዎችህ ግን ሁላችን ጋሻ ጦራችንን ይዘን በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ጌታችን እንደ ተናገረ ወደ ጦርነት እንሄዳለን።

verses.en: But thy servants will pass over, every man armed for war, before YAHUAH to battle, as my lord saith.
verses.am: ሙሴም ካህኑን አልዓዛርን የነዌንም ልጅ ኢያሱን የእስራኤልንም ልጆች ነገድ አለቆች ስለ እነርሱ አዘዘ።

verses.en: So concerning them Mosheh commanded Eleazar the priest, and Yahoshua the son of Nun, and the chief fathers of the tribes of the children of Yisra'el:
verses.am: ሙሴም። የጋድና የሮቤል ልጆች ሁላቸው ጋሻ ጦራቸውን ይዘው ከእናንተ ጋር በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ዮርዳኖስን ቢሻገሩ፥ ምድሪቱንም ድል ብትነሡ፥ የገለዓድን ምድር ርስት አድርጋችሁ ትሰጡአቸዋላችሁ።

verses.en: And Mosheh said unto them, If the children of Gad and the children of Reuben will pass with you over Jordan, every man armed to battle, before YAHUAH, and the land shall be subdued before you; then ye shall give them the land of Gilead for a possession:
verses.am: ጋሻ ጦራቸውን ይዘው ከእናንተ ጋር ባይሻገሩ ግን በከነዓን ምድር በእናንተ መካከል ርስታቸውን ይወርሳሉ አላቸው።

verses.en: But if they will not pass over with you armed, they shall have possessions among you in the land of Canaan.
verses.am: የጋድና የሮቤልም ልጆች መልሰው። እግዚአብሔር ለእኛ ለባሪያዎችህ እንደ ተናገረ እንዲሁ እናደርጋለን።

verses.en: And the children of Gad and the children of Reuben answered, saying, As YAHUAH hath said unto thy servants, so will we do.
verses.am: ጋሻ ጦራችንን ይዘን በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ወደ ከነዓን ምድር እንሻገራለን፥ ከዮርዳኖስም ማዶ ከወዲሁ የወረስነው ርስት ይሆንልናል አሉት።

verses.en: We will pass over armed before YAHUAH into the land of Canaan, that the possession of our inheritance on this side Jordan may be ours.
verses.am: ሙሴም ለጋድና ለሮቤል ልጆች ለዮሴፍም ልጅ ለምናሴ ነገድ እኩሌታ፥ የአሞራውያንን ንጉሥ የሴዎንን ግዛት የባሳንንም ንጉሥ የዐግን ግዛት፥ ምድሪቱንና በዙሪያዋ ያሉትን ከተሞች ሰጣቸው።

verses.en: And Mosheh gave unto them, even to the children of Gad, and to the children of Reuben, and unto half the tribe of Manasseh the son of Yoseph, the kingdom of Sihon king of the Amorites, and the kingdom of Og king of Bashan, the land, with the cities thereof in the coasts, even the cities of the country round about.
verses.am: የጋድም ልጆች ዲቦንን፥ አጣሮትን፥ አሮዔርን፥

verses.en: And the children of Gad built Dibon, and Ataroth, and Aroer,
verses.am: ዓጥሮትሽፋንን፥ ኢያዜርን፥ ዮግብሃን፥

verses.en: And Atroth, Shophan, and Jaazer, and Jogbehah,
verses.am: ቤትነምራን፥ ቤትሃራንን የተመሸጉ ከተሞች አድርገው ሠሩ፤ የበጎች በረቶችንም ሠሩ።

verses.en: And Bethnimrah, and Bethharan, fenced cities: and folds for sheep.
verses.am: የሮቤልም ልጆች ሐሴቦንን፥ ኤልያሊን፥

verses.en: And the children of Reuben built Heshbon, and Elealeh, and Kirjathaim,
verses.am: ቂርያታይምን፥ ስማቸውም የተለወጠውን ናባውን፥ በኣልሜዎንን፥ ሴባማን ሠሩ፤ እነዚህንም የሠሩአቸውን ከተሞች በሌላ ስም ጠሩአቸው።

verses.en: And Nebo, and Baalmeon, (their names being changed,) and Shibmah: and gave other names unto the cities which they builded.
verses.am: የምናሴም ልጅ የማኪር ልጆች ወደ ገለዓድ ሄዱ፥ ወሰዱአትም፥ በእርስዋም የነበሩትን አሞራውያንን አሳደዱ።

verses.en: And the children of Machir the son of Manasseh went to Gilead, and took it, and dispossessed the Amorite which was in it.
verses.am: ሙሴም ለምናሴ ልጅ ለማኪር ገለዓድን ሰጠ፤ በእርስዋም ተቀመጠ።

verses.en: And Mosheh gave Gilead unto Machir the son of Manasseh; and he dwelt therein.
verses.am: የምናሴም ልጅ ኢያዕር ሄዶ መንደሮችዋን ወሰደ፥ የኢያዕርም መንደሮች ብሎ ጠራቸው።

verses.en: And Jair the son of Manasseh went and took the small towns thereof, and called them Havothjair.
verses.am: ኖባህም ሄደ ቄናትንም መንደሮችዋንም ወሰደ፥ በስሙም ኖባህ ብሎ ጠራቸው።

verses.en: And Nobah went and took Kenath, and the villages thereof, and called it Nobah, after his own name.
These are the journeys of the children of Yisra'el, which went forth out of the land of Mitsrayim with their armies under the hand of Mosheh and Aaron.
verses.am: የእስራኤልም ልጆች ጕዞ ከሙሴና ከአሮን እጅ በታች በጭፍሮቻቸው ከግብፅ በወጡ ጊዜ እንዲህ ነበረ።

verses.en: And Mosheh wrote their goings out according to their journeys by the commandment of YAHUAH: and these are their journeys according to their goings out.
verses.am: ሙሴም በእግዚአብሔር ትእዛዝ እንደ ጕዞአቸው አወጣጣቸውን ጻፈ፤ እንደ አወጣጣቸውም ጕዞአቸው እንዲህ ነበረ።

verses.en: And they departed from Rameses in the first month, on the fifteenth day of the first month; on the morrow after the passover the children of Yisra'el went out with an high hand in the sight of all the Mitsrim.
verses.am: በመጀመሪያው ወር ከወሩም በአሥራ አምስተኛው ቀን ከራምሴ ተጓዙ፤ ከፋሲካ በኋላ በነጋው የእስራኤል ልጆች ግብፃውያን ሁሉ እያዩ ከፍ ባለች እጅ ወጡ።

verses.en: For the Mitsrim buried all their firstborn, which YAHUAH had smitten among them: upon their elohim also YAHUAH executed judgments.
verses.am: በዚያም ጊዜ ግብፃውያን እግዚአብሔር የገደላቸውን በኵሮቻቸውን ይቀብሩ ነበር፤ በአማልክቶቻቸውም ደግሞ እግዚአብሔር ፈረደባቸው።

verses.en: And the children of Yisra'el removed from Rameses, and pitched in Succoth.
verses.am: የእስራኤልም ልጆች ከራምሴ ተጕዘው በሱኮት ሰፈሩ።

verses.en: And they departed from Succoth, and pitched in Etham, which is in the edge of the wilderness.
verses.am: ከሱኮትም ተጕዘው በምድረ በዳ ዳርቻ ባለች በኤታም ሰፈሩ።

verses.en: And they removed from Etham, and turned again unto Pihahiroth, which is before Baalzephon: and they pitched before Migdol.
verses.am: ከኤታምም ተጕዘው በበኣልዛፎን ፊት ወደ ነበረች ወደ ፊሀሒሮት ተመለሱ፤ በሚግዶልም ፊት ለፊት ሰፈሩ።

verses.en: And they departed from before Pihahiroth, and passed through the midst of the sea into the wilderness, and went three days' journey in the wilderness of Etham, and pitched in Marah.
verses.am: ከፊሀሒሮትም ተጕዘው በባሕሩ ውስጥ ወደ ምድረ በዳ አለፉ፤ በኤታምም በረሀ የሦስት ቀን መንገድ ሄደው በማራ ሰፈሩ።

verses.en: And they removed from Marah, and came unto Elim: and in Elim were twelve fountains of water, and threescore and ten palm trees; and they pitched there.
verses.am: ከማራም ተጕዘው ወደ ኤሊም መጡ፤ በኤሊምም አሥራ ሁለት የውኃ ምንጮች ሰባ ዘንባቦችም ነበሩ፤ በዚያም ሰፈሩ።

verses.en: And they removed from Elim, and encamped by the Red sea.
verses.am: ከኤሊምም ተጕዘው በኤርትራ ባሕር ዳር ሰፈሩ።

verses.en: And they removed from the Red sea, and encamped in the wilderness of Sin.
verses.am: ከኤርትራም ባሕር ተጕዘው በሲን ምድረ በዳ ሰፈሩ።

verses.en: And they took their journey out of the wilderness of Sin, and encamped in Dophkah.
verses.am: ከሲን ምድረ በዳም ተጕዘው በራፋቃ ሰፈሩ።

verses.en: And they departed from Dophkah, and encamped in Alush.
verses.am: ከራፋቃም ተጕዘው በኤሉስ ሰፈሩ።

verses.en: And they removed from Alush, and encamped at Rephidim, where was no water for the people to drink.
verses.am: ከኤሉስም ተጕዘው በራፊዲም ሰፈሩ፤ በዚያም ሕዝቡ የሚጠጡት ውኃ አልነበረም።

verses.en: And they departed from Rephidim, and pitched in the wilderness of Sinai.
verses.am: ከራፊዲምም ተጕዘው በሲና ምድረ በዳ ሰፈሩ።

verses.en: And they removed from the desert of Sinai, and pitched at Kibrothhattaavah.
verses.am: ከሲናም ምድረ በዳ ተጕዘው በምኞት መቃብር ሰፈሩ።

verses.en: And they departed from Kibrothhattaavah, and encamped at Hazeroth.
verses.am: ከምኞት መቃብርም ተጕዘው በሐጼሮት ሰፈሩ።

verses.en: And they departed from Hazeroth, and pitched in Rithmah.
verses.am: ከሐጼሮትም ተጕዘው በሪትማ ሰፈሩ።

verses.en: And they departed from Rithmah, and pitched at Rimmonparez.
verses.am: ከሪትማም ተጕዘው በሬሞን ዘፋሬስ ሰፈሩ።

verses.en: And they departed from Rimmonparez, and pitched in Libnah.
verses.am: ከሬሞን ዘፋሬስም ተጕዘው በልብና ሰፈሩ።

verses.en: And they removed from Libnah, and pitched at Rissah.
verses.am: ከልብናም ተጕዘው በሪሳ ሰፈሩ።

verses.en: And they journeyed from Rissah, and pitched in Kehelathah.
verses.am: ከሪሳም ተጕዘው በቀሄላታ ሰፈሩ።

verses.en: And they went from Kehelathah, and pitched in mount Shapher.
verses.am: ከቀሄላታም ተጕዘው በሻፍር ተራራ ሰፈሩ።

verses.en: And they removed from mount Shapher, and encamped in Haradah.
verses.am: ከሻፍር ተራራም ተጕዘው በሐራዳ ሰፈሩ።

verses.en: And they removed from Haradah, and pitched in Makheloth.
verses.am: ከሐራዳም ተጕዘው በመቅሄሎት ሰፈሩ።

verses.en: And they removed from Makheloth, and encamped at Tahath.
verses.am: ከመቅሄሎትም ተጕዘው በታሐት ሰፈሩ።

verses.en: And they departed from Tahath, and pitched at Tarah.
verses.am: ከታሐትም ተጕዘው በታራ ሰፈሩ።

verses.en: And they removed from Tarah, and pitched in Mithcah.
verses.am: ከታራም ተጕዘው በሚትቃ ሰፈሩ።

verses.en: And they went from Mithcah, and pitched in Hashmonah.
verses.am: ከሚትቃም ተጕዘው በሐሽሞና ሰፈሩ።

verses.en: And they departed from Hashmonah, and encamped at Moseroth.
verses.am: ከሐሽሞናም ተጕዘው በሞሴሮት ሰፈሩ።

verses.en: And they departed from Moseroth, and pitched in Benejaakan.
verses.am: ከሞሴሮትም ተጕዘው በብኔያዕቃን ሰፈሩ።

verses.en: And they removed from Benejaakan, and encamped at Horhagidgad.
verses.am: ከብኔያዕቃንም ተጕዘው በሖርሃጊድጋድ ሰፈሩ።

verses.en: And they went from Horhagidgad, and pitched in Jotbathah.
verses.am: ከሖርሃጊድጋድም ተጕዘው በዮጥባታ ሰፈሩ።

verses.en: And they removed from Jotbathah, and encamped at Ebronah.
verses.am: ከዮጥባታም ተጕዘው በዔብሮና ሰፈሩ።

verses.en: And they departed from Ebronah, and encamped at Eziongaber.
verses.am: ከዔብሮናም ተጕዘው በዔጽዮንጋብር ሰፈሩ።

verses.en: And they removed from Eziongaber, and pitched in the wilderness of Zin, which is Kadesh.
verses.am: ከዔጽዮንጋብርም ተጕዘው በጺን ምድረ በዳ ሰፈሩ፤ ይህችም ቃዴስ ናት።

verses.en: And they removed from Kadesh, and pitched in mount Hor, in the edge of the land of Edom.
verses.am: ከቃዴስም ተጕዘው በኤዶምያስ ምድር ዳርቻ ባለው በሖር ተራራ ሰፈሩ።

verses.en: And Aaron the priest went up into mount Hor at the commandment of YAHUAH, and died there, in the fortieth year after the children of Yisra'el were come out of the land of Mitsrayim, in the first day of the fifth month.
verses.am: ካህኑም አሮን በእግዚአብሔር ትእዛዝ ወደ ሖር ተራራ ላይ ወጣ፥ በዚያም የእስራኤል ልጆች ከግብፅ ምድር ከወጡ በኋላ በአርባኛው ዓመት በአምስተኛው ወር ከወሩም በመጀመሪያው ቀን ሞተ።

verses.en: And Aaron was an hundred and twenty and three years old when he died in mount Hor.
verses.am: አሮንም በሖር ተራራ በሞተ ጊዜ ዕድሜው መቶ ሀያ ሦስት ዓመት ነበር።

verses.en: And king Arad the Canaanite, which dwelt in the south in the land of Canaan, heard of the coming of the children of Yisra'el.
verses.am: በከነዓን ምድርም በደቡብ በኩል ተቀምጦ የነበረው ከነዓናዊው የዓራድ ንጉሥ የእስራኤል ልጆች እንደ መጡ ሰማ።

verses.en: And they departed from mount Hor, and pitched in Zalmonah.
verses.am: እነርሱም ከሖር ተራራ ተጕዘው በሴልሞና ሰፈሩ።

verses.en: And they departed from Zalmonah, and pitched in Punon.
verses.am: ከሴልሞናም ተጕዘው በፉኖን ሰፈሩ።

verses.en: And they departed from Punon, and pitched in Oboth.
verses.am: ከፉኖንም ተጕዘው በኦቦት ሰፈሩ።

verses.en: And they departed from Oboth, and pitched in Ijeabarim, in the border of Moab.
verses.am: ከኦቦትም ተጕዘው በሞዓብ ዳርቻ ባለው በጋይ ሰፈሩ።

verses.en: And they departed from Iim, and pitched in Dibongad.
verses.am: ከጋይም ተጕዘው በዲቦንጋድ ሰፈሩ።

verses.en: And they removed from Dibongad, and encamped in Almondiblathaim.
verses.am: ከዲቦንጋድም ተጕዘው በዓልሞንዲብላታይም ሰፈሩ።

verses.en: And they removed from Almondiblathaim, and pitched in the mountains of Abarim, before Nebo.
verses.am: ከዓልሞንዲብላታይምም ተጕዘው በናባው ፊት ባሉ በዓብሪም ተራሮች ላይ ሰፈሩ።

verses.en: And they departed from the mountains of Abarim, and pitched in the plains of Moab by Jordan near Jericho.
verses.am: ከዓብሪምም ተራሮች ተጕዘው በዮርዳኖስ አጠገብ በኢያሪኮ ፊት ባለው በሞዓብ ሜዳ ላይ ሰፈሩ።

verses.en: And they pitched by Jordan, from Bethjesimoth even unto Abelshittim in the plains of Moab.
verses.am: በዮርዳኖስም አጠገብ በሞዓብ ሜዳ ላይ ከቤትየሺሞት እስከ አቤልሰጢም ድረስ ሰፈሩ።

verses.en: And YAHUAH spake unto Mosheh in the plains of Moab by Jordan near Jericho, saying,
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን በዮርዳኖስ አጠገብ በኢያሪኮ ፊት ለፊት በሞዓብ ሜዳ ላይ እንዲህ ብሎ ተናገረው።

verses.en: Speak unto the children of Yisra'el, and say unto them, When ye are passed over Jordan into the land of Canaan;
verses.am: ለእስራኤል ልጆች እንዲህ ብለህ ንገራቸው። ወደከነዓን ምድር ዮርዳኖስን በተሻገራችሁ ጊዜ፥

verses.en: Then ye shall drive out all the inhabitants of the land from before you, and destroy all their pictures, and destroy all their molten images, and quite pluck down all their high places:
verses.am: የአገሩን ሰዎች ሁሉ ከፊታችሁ ታሳድዳላችሁ፥ የተቀረጹትንም ድንጋዮቻቸውን ሁሉ ታጠፋላችሁ፥ ቀልጠው የተሠሩትንም ምስሎቻቸውን ሁሉ ታጠፋላችሁ፥ በኮረብታ ላይ ያሉትን መስገጃዎቻቸውንም ታፈርሳላችሁ፤

verses.en: And ye shall dispossess the inhabitants of the land, and dwell therein: for I have given you the land to possess it.
verses.am: ምድሪቱንም ለእናንተ ርስት አድርጌ ሰጥቼአችኋለሁና ምድሪቱን ትወርሱአታላችሁ ትቀመጡባታላችሁም።

verses.en: And ye shall divide the land by lot for an inheritance among your families: and to the more ye shall give the more inheritance, and to the fewer ye shall give the less inheritance: every man's inheritance shall be in the place where his lot falleth; according to the tribes of your fathers ye shall inherit.
verses.am: ምድሪቱንም በየወገኖቻችሁ በዕጣ ትወርሳላችሁ፤ ለብዙዎች እንደ ብዛታቸው ለጥቂቶቹም እንደ ጥቂትነታቸው መጠን ርስትን ትሰጣላችሁ፤ እያዳንዱ ሁሉ ዕጣ እንደ ወደቀለት በዚያ ርስቱ ይሆናል፤ በየአባቶቻችሁ ነገዶች ትወርሳላችሁ።

verses.en: But if ye will not drive out the inhabitants of the land from before you; then it shall come to pass, that those which ye let remain of them shall be pricks in your eyes, and thorns in your sides, and shall vex you in the land wherein ye dwell.
verses.am: የአገሩንም ሰዎች ከፊታችሁ ባታሳድዱ፥ ያስቀራችኋቸው ለዓይናችሁ እንደ እሾህ ለጎናችሁም እንደሚወጋ ነገር ይሆኑባችኋል፥ በምትቀመጡባትም ምድር ያስጨንቁአችኋል።

verses.en: Moreover it shall come to pass, that I shall do unto you, as I thought to do unto them.
verses.am: እኔም በእነርሱ አደርገው ዘንድ ያሰብሁትን በእናንተ አደርግባችኋለሁ።

verses.en: And YAHUAH spake unto Mosheh, saying,
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን እንዲህ ብሎ ተናገረው።

verses.en: Command the children of Yisra'el, and say unto them, When ye come into the land of Canaan; (this is the land that shall fall unto you for an inheritance, even the land of Canaan with the coasts thereof:)
verses.am: የእስራኤልን ልጆች እንዲህ ብለህ እዘዛቸው። ወደ ከነዓን ምድር በገባችሁ ጊዜ፥ ርስት ትሆናችሁ ዘንድ በዕጣ የምትደርሳችሁ ምድር፥ በዳርቻዋ ያለች የከነዓን ምድር፥

verses.en: Then your south quarter shall be from the wilderness of Zin along by the coast of Edom, and your south border shall be the outmost coast of the salt sea eastward:
verses.am: ይህች ናት፤ የደቡቡ ወገን ከጺን ምድረ በዳ በኤዶምያስ በኩል ይሆናል፤ የደቡቡም ዳርቻ ከጨው ባሕር ዳር በምሥራቅ በኩል ይጀምራል፤

verses.en: And your border shall turn from the south to the ascent of Akrabbim, and pass on to Zin: and the going forth thereof shall be from the south to Kadeshbarnea, and shall go on to Hazaraddar, and pass on to Azmon:
verses.am: ዳርቻችሁም በአቅረቢም ዐቀበት በደቡብ በኩል ይዞራል ወደ ጺንም ያልፋል፤ መውጫውም በቃዴስ በርኔ በደቡብ በኩል ይሆናል፤ ወደ ሐጸርአዳር ይሄዳል ወደ ዓጽሞንም ያልፋል፤

verses.en: And the border shall fetch a compass from Azmon unto the river of Mitsrayim, and the goings out of it shall be at the sea.
verses.am: ዳርቻውም ከዓጽሞን ወደ ግብፅ ወንዝ ይዞራል፥ መውጫውም በባሕሩ በኩል ይሆናል።

verses.en: And as for the western border, ye shall even have the great sea for a border: this shall be your west border.
verses.am: ለምዕራብም ዳርቻ ታላቁ ባሕር ዳርቻችሁ ይሆናል፤ ይህ የምዕራብ ዳርቻችሁ ይሆናል።

verses.en: And this shall be your north border: from the great sea ye shall point out for you mount Hor:
verses.am: የሰሜንም ዳርቻችሁ ይህ ይሆናል፤ ከታላቁ ባሕር ወደ ሖር ተራራ ምልክት ታመለክታላችሁ፤

verses.en: From mount Hor ye shall point out your border unto the entrance of Hamath; and the goings forth of the border shall be to Zedad:
verses.am: ከሖርም ተራራ ወደ ሐማት መግቢያ ምልክት ታመለክታላችሁ የዳርቻውም መውጫ በጽዳድ ይሆናል፤

verses.en: And the border shall go on to Ziphron, and the goings out of it shall be at Hazarenan: this shall be your north border.
verses.am: ዳርቻውም ወደ ዚፍሮን ያልፋል እስከ ሐጸርዔናንም ድረስ ይወጣል፤ ይህ የሰሜን ዳርቻችሁ ይሆናል።

verses.en: And ye shall point out your east border from Hazarenan to Shepham:
verses.am: የምሥራቁንም ዳርቻችሁን ከሐጸርዔናን ወደ ሴፋማ ምልክት ታመለክታላችሁ፤

verses.en: And the coast shall go down from Shepham to Riblah, on the east side of Ain; and the border shall descend, and shall reach unto the side of the sea of Chinnereth eastward:
verses.am: ዳርቻውም ከሴፋማ በዓይን ምሥራቅ ወዳለው ወደ ሪብላ ይወርዳል፤ እስከ ኪኔሬት የባሕር ወሽመጥ በምሥራቅ በኩል ይደርሳል፤

verses.en: And the border shall go down to Jordan, and the goings out of it shall be at the salt sea: this shall be your land with the coasts thereof round about.
verses.am: ዳርቻውም ወደ ዮርዳኖስ ይወርዳል፥ መውጫውም በጨው ባሕር ይሆናል። ምድራችሁ እንደ ዳርቻዋ በዙሪያዋ ይህች ናት።

verses.en: And Mosheh commanded the children of Yisra'el, saying, This is the land which ye shall inherit by lot, which YAHUAH commanded to give unto the nine tribes, and to the half tribe:
verses.am: ሙሴም የእስራኤልን ልጆች እንዲህ ብሎ አዘዛቸው። እግዚአብሔር ለዘጠኝ ነገድ ተኩል ይሰጡአቸው ዘንድ ያዘዘ በዕጣ የምትወርሱአት ምድር ይህች ናት፤

verses.en: For the tribe of the children of Reuben according to the house of their fathers, and the tribe of the children of Gad according to the house of their fathers, have received their inheritance; and half the tribe of Manasseh have received their inheritance:
verses.am: የሮቤልም ልጆች ነገድ በየአባቶቻቸው ቤት፥ የጋድም ልጆች ነገድ በየአባቶቻቸው ቤት፥ የምናሴም ነገድ እኩሌታ ርስታቸውን ወርሰዋል።

verses.en: The two tribes and the half tribe have received their inheritance on this side Jordan near Jericho eastward, toward the sunrising.
verses.am: እነዚህ ሁለቱ ነገድና የአንዱ ነገድ እኩሌታ ርስታቸውን በዮርዳኖስ ማዶ በኢያሪኮ አንጻር በምሥራቅ በኩል ወረሱ።

verses.en: And YAHUAH spake unto Mosheh, saying,
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን እንዲህ ብሎ ተናገረው።

verses.en: These are the names of the men which shall divide the land unto you: Eleazar the priest, and Yahoshua the son of Nun.
verses.am: ምድሪቱን ርስት አድርገው የሚከፍሉላችሁ ሰዎች ስማቸው ይህ ነው፤ ካህኑ አልዓዛርና የነዌ ልጅ ኢያሱ።

verses.en: And ye shall take one prince of every tribe, to divide the land by inheritance.
verses.am: ምድሪቱንም ርስት አድርገው ይከፍሉ ዘንድ ከየነገዱ አንድ አንድ አለቃ ትወስዳላችሁ።

verses.en: And the names of the men are these: Of the tribe of Yehudah, Caleb the son of Jephunneh.
verses.am: የሰዎቹም ስም ይህ ነው፤ ከይሁዳ ነገድ የዮፎኒ ልጅ ካሌብ፥

verses.en: And of the tribe of the children of Simeon, Shemuel the son of Ammihud.
verses.am: ከስምዖን ልጆች ነገድ የዓሚሁድ ልጅ ሰላሚኤል፥

verses.en: Of the tribe of Benjamin, Elidad the son of Chislon.
verses.am: ከብንያም ነገድ የኪስሎን ልጅ ኤልዳድ፥

verses.en: And the prince of the tribe of the children of Dan, Bukki the son of Jogli.
verses.am: ከዳን ልጆች ንገድ አንድ አለቃ የዮግሊ ልጅ ቡቂ፥

verses.en: The prince of the children of Yoseph, for the tribe of the children of Manasseh, Hanniel the son of Ephod.
verses.am: ከዮሴፍም ልጆች ከምናሴ ልጆች ነገድ አንድ አለቃ የሱፊድ ልጅ አኒኤል፥

verses.en: And the prince of the tribe of the children of Ephraim, Kemuel the son of Shiphtan.
verses.am: ከኤፍሬም ልጆች ነገድ አንድ አለቃ የሺፍጣን ልጅ ቀሙኤል፥

verses.en: And the prince of the tribe of the children of Zebulun, Elizaphan the son of Parnach.
verses.am: ከዛብሎን ልጆች ነገድ አንድ አለቃ የፈርናክ ልጅ ኤሊሳፈን፥

verses.en: And the prince of the tribe of the children of Issachar, Paltiel the son of Azzan.
verses.am: ከይሳኮር ልጆች ነገድ አንድ አለቃ የሖዛ ልጅ ፈልጢኤል፥

verses.en: And the prince of the tribe of the children of Asher, Ahihud the son of Shelomi.
verses.am: ከአሴር ልጆች ነገድ አንድ አለቃ የሴሌሚ ልጅ አሒሁድ፥

verses.en: And the prince of the tribe of the children of Naphtali, Pedahel the son of Ammihud.
verses.am: ከንፍታሌም ልጆች ነገድ አንድ አለቃ የዓሚሁድ ልጅ ፈዳሄል።

verses.en: These are they whom YAHUAH commanded to divide the inheritance unto the children of Yisra'el in the land of Canaan.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር በከነዓን ምድር ለእስራኤል ልጆች ርስታቸውን ይከፍሉ ዘንድ ያዘዛቸው እነዚህ ናቸው።

verses.en: And YAHUAH spake unto Mosheh in the plains of Moab by Jordan near Jericho, saying,
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን በዮርዳኖስ አጠገብ በኢያሪኮ አንጻር በሞዓብ ሜዳ እንዲህ ብሎ ተናገረው።

verses.en: Command the children of Yisra'el, that they give unto the Levites of the inheritance of their possession cities to dwell in; and ye shall give also unto the Levites suburbs for the cities round about them.
verses.am: ሌዋውያን የሚቀመጡባቸውን ከተሞች ከርስታቸው ይሰጡ ዘንድ የእስራኤልን ልጆች እዘዛቸው፤ በከተሞቹም ዙሪያ ያለውን መሰምርያ ለሌዋውያን ስጡ።

verses.en: And the cities shall they have to dwell in; and the suburbs of them shall be for their cattle, and for their goods, and for all their beasts.
verses.am: እነርሱም በከተሞቹ ውስጥ ይቀመጣሉ፤ መሰምርያቸውም ለከብቶቻቸው ለእንስሶቻቸውም ለእነርሱም ላለው ሁሉ ይሁን።

verses.en: And the suburbs of the cities, which ye shall give unto the Levites, shall reach from the wall of the city and outward a thousand cubits round about.
verses.am: ለሌዋውያንም የምትሰጡት የከተማ መሰምርያ በከተማው ዙሪያ ከቅጥሩ ወደ ውጭ አንድ ሺህ ክንድ ይሁን።

verses.en: And ye shall measure from without the city on the east side two thousand cubits, and on the south side two thousand cubits, and on the west side two thousand cubits, and on the north side two thousand cubits; and the city shall be in the midst: this shall be to them the suburbs of the cities.
verses.am: ከከተማው ውጭ በምሥራቅ በኩል ሁለት ሺህ ክንድ፥ በደቡብ በኩል ሁለት ሺህ ክንድ፥ በምዕራብ በኩል ሁለት ሺህ ክንድ፥ በሰሜንም በኩል ሁለት ሺህ ክንድ ትከነዳላችሁ፥ ከተማውም በመካከል ይሆናል፤ ይህም የከተሞቹ መሰምርያ ይሆንላቸዋል።

verses.en: And among the cities which ye shall give unto the Levites there shall be six cities for refuge, which ye shall appoint for the manslayer, that he may flee thither: and to them ye shall add forty and two cities.
verses.am: ለሌዋውያንም የምትሰጡአቸው ስድስቱ የመማፀኛ ከተሞች ናቸው፤ እነርሱም ነፍሰ ገዳይ ይሸሽባቸው ዘንድ የምትሰጡአቸው ናቸው፤ ከእነዚህም ሌላ አርባ ሁለት ከተሞች ትሰጣላችሁ።

verses.en: So all the cities which ye shall give to the Levites shall be forty and eight cities: them shall ye give with their suburbs.
verses.am: ለሌዋውያን የምትሰጡአቸው ከተሞች ሁሉ አርባ ስምንት ከተሞች ይሆናሉ፤ ከመሰምርያቸው ጋር ትሰጡአቸዋላችሁ።

verses.en: And the cities which ye shall give shall be of the possession of the children of Yisra'el: from them that have many ye shall give many; but from them that have few ye shall give few: every one shall give of his cities unto the Levites according to his inheritance which he inheriteth.
verses.am: ከእስራኤል ልጆች ርስት ለሌዋውያን የምትሰጡአቸውን ከተሞች እንዲሁ ስጡ፤ ከብዙዎቹ ብዙ፥ ከጥቂቶቹ ጥቂት ትወስዳላችሁ፤ እያንዳንዱ እንደ ወረሱት እንደ ርስታቸው መጠን ከከተሞቻቸው ለሌዋውያን ይሰጣሉ።

verses.en: And YAHUAH spake unto Mosheh, saying,
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን እንዲህ ብሎ ተናገረው።

verses.en: Speak unto the children of Yisra'el, and say unto them, When ye be come over Jordan into the land of Canaan;
verses.am: ለእስራኤል ልጆች እንዲህ ብለህ ንገራቸው። ወደ ከነዓን ምድር ዮርዳኖስን በተሻገራችሁ ጊዜ፥

verses.en: Then ye shall appoint you cities to be cities of refuge for you; that the slayer may flee thither, which killeth any person at unawares.
verses.am: በስሕተት ነፍስ የገደለ ወደዚያ ይሸሽ ዘንድ የመማፀኛ ከተሞች እንዲሆኑላችሁ ከተሞችን ለእናንት ለዩ።

verses.en: And they shall be unto you cities for refuge from the avenger; that the manslayer die not, until he stand before the congregation in judgment.
verses.am: ነፍሰ ገዳዩ በማኅበሩ ፊት ለፍርድ እስኪቆም ድረስ እንዳይሞት፥ ከተሞቹም ከደም ተበቃይ የመማፀኛ ከተሞች ይሁኑላችሁ።

verses.en: And of these cities which ye shall give six cities shall ye have for refuge.
verses.am: የምትሰጡአቸውም ስድስቱ ከተሞች የመማፀኛ ከተሞች ይሁኑላችሁ።

verses.en: Ye shall give three cities on this side Jordan, and three cities shall ye give in the land of Canaan, which shall be cities of refuge.
verses.am: በዮርዳኖስ ማዶ ሦስት ከተሞች ትሰጣላችሁ፥ በከነዓንም ምድር ሦስት ከተሞች ትሰጣላችሁ፤ የመማፀኛ ከተሞች ይሆናሉ።

verses.en: These six cities shall be a refuge, both for the children of Yisra'el, and for the stranger, and for the sojourner among them: that every one that killeth any person unawares may flee thither.
verses.am: በስሕተት ነፍስ የገደለ ይሸሽበት ዘንድ እነዚህ ስድስት ከተሞች ለእስራኤል ልጆች በመካከላቸው ለሚቀመጡ እንግዶችና መጻተኞች መማፀኛ ይሆናሉ።

verses.en: And if he smite him with an instrument of iron, so that he die, he is a murderer: the murderer shall surely be put to death.
verses.am: በብረት መሣርያ እስኪሞት ድረስ ቢመታው ነፍሰ ገዳይ ነው፤ ነፍሰ ገዳዩም ፈጽሞ ይገደል።

verses.en: And if he smite him with throwing a stone, wherewith he may die, and he die, he is a murderer: the murderer shall surely be put to death.
verses.am: ሰውም በሚሞትበት በእጁ ባለው ድንጋይ ቢመታው የተመታውም ቢሞት፥ እርሱ ነፍሰ ገዳይ ነው፤ ነፍሰ ገዳዩም ፈጽሞ ይገደል።

verses.en: Or if he smite him with an hand weapon of wood, wherewith he may die, and he die, he is a murderer: the murderer shall surely be put to death.
verses.am: ሰውም በሚሞትበት በእጁ ባለው በእንጨት መሣርያ ቢመታው የተመታውም ቢሞት፥ እርሱ ነፍሰ ገዳይ ነው፤ ነፍሰ ገዳዩም ፈጽሞ ይገደል።

verses.en: The revenger of blood himself shall slay the murderer: when he meeteth him, he shall slay him.
verses.am: ደም ተበቃዩ ራሱ ነፍሰ ገዳዩን ይግደል፤ ባገኘው ጊዜ ይግደለው።

verses.en: But if he thrust him of hatred, or hurl at him by laying of wait, that he die;
verses.am: እስኪሞት ድረስ በጥላቻ ቢደፋው፥ ወይም ሸምቆ አንዳች ነገር ቢጥልበት፥

verses.en: Or in enmity smite him with his hand, that he die: he that smote him shall surely be put to death; for he is a murderer: the revenger of blood shall slay the murderer, when he meeteth him.
verses.am: ወይም በጥላቻ እስኪሞት ድረስ በእጁ ቢመታው፥ የመታው ፈጽሞ ይገደል፤ ነፍሰ ገዳይ ነው፤ ደም ተበቃዩ ባገኘው ጊዜ ነፍሰ ገዳዩን ይግደለው።

verses.en: But if he thrust him suddenly without enmity, or have cast upon him any thing without laying of wait,
verses.am: ነገር ግን ያለ ጥላቻ ድንገት ቢደፋው፥ ሳይሸምቅም አንዳች ነገር ቢጥልበት፥

verses.en: Or with any stone, wherewith a man may die, seeing him not, and cast it upon him, that he die, and was not his enemy, neither sought his harm:
verses.am: ወይም ሳያየው እስኪሞት ድረስ ሰው የሚሞትበትን ድንጋይ ቢጥልበት፥ ጠላቱም ባይሆን፥ ክፉም ያደርግበት ዘንድ ባይሻ፥

verses.en: Then the congregation shall judge between the slayer and the revenger of blood according to these judgments:
verses.am: ማኅበሩ በመቺውና በደም ተባቃዩ መካከል ፍርድን እንደዚሁ ይፍረድ፤

verses.en: And the congregation shall deliver the slayer out of the hand of the revenger of blood, and the congregation shall restore him to the city of his refuge, whither he was fled: and he shall abide in it unto the death of the high priest, which was anointed with the holy oil.
verses.am: ማኅበሩም ነፍሰ ገዳዩን ከደም ተበቃዩ እጅ ያድነዋል፥ ማኅበሩም ወደ ሸሸበት ወደ መማፀኛ ከተማ ይመልሰዋል፤ በቅዱስ ዘይትም የተቀባው ዋነኛው ካህን እስኪሞት ድረስ በዚያ ይቀመጣል።

verses.en: But if the slayer shall at any time come without the border of the city of his refuge, whither he was fled;
verses.am: ነፍሰ ገዳዩ ግን ከሸሸበት ከመማፀኛው ከተማ ዳርቻ ቢወጣ፥

verses.en: And the revenger of blood find him without the borders of the city of his refuge, and the revenger of blood kill the slayer; he shall not be guilty of blood:
verses.am: ደም ተበቃዩም ከመማፀኛው ከተማ ዳርቻ ውጭ ቢያገኘው፥ ደም ተበቃዩም ነፍሰ ገዳዩን ቢገድለው፥ የደም ዕዳ አይሆንበትም፤

verses.en: Because he should have remained in the city of his refuge until the death of the high priest: but after the death of the high priest the slayer shall return into the land of his possession.
verses.am: ዋነኛው ካህን እስኪሞት ድረሰ በመማፀኛው ከተማ ውስጥ መቀመጥ ይገባው ነበርና። ዋነኛው ካህን ከሞተ በኋላ ግን ነፍሰ ገዳዩ ወደ ርስቱ ምድር ይመለሳል።

verses.en: So these things shall be for a statute of judgment unto you throughout your generations in all your dwellings.
verses.am: እነዚህም ነገሮች ለልጅ ልጃችሁ በማደሪያችሁ ሁሉ ሥርዓትና ፍርድ ይሁኑላችሁ።

verses.en: Whoso killeth any person, the murderer shall be put to death by the mouth of witnesses: but one witness shall not testify against any person to cause him to die.
verses.am: ነፍሰ ገዳይ ሁሉ በምስክሮች አፍ ይገደላል፤ በአንድ ምስክር ግን ማናቸውንም ሰው መግደል አይገባም።

verses.en: Moreover ye shall take no satisfaction for the life of a murderer, which is guilty of death: but he shall be surely put to death.
verses.am: ሞት የተፈረደበትን ነፍሰ ገዳዩንም ለማዳን የነፍስ ዋጋ አትቀበሉ፤ እርሱ ፈጽሞ ይገደል።

verses.en: And ye shall take no satisfaction for him that is fled to the city of his refuge, that he should come again to dwell in the land, until the death of the priest.
verses.am: ዋነኛው ካህን ሳይሞት ወደ ምድሩ ይመለስ ዘንድ ወደ መማፀኛው ከተማ ከሸሸው የነፍስ ዋጋ አትቀበሉ።

verses.en: So ye shall not pollute the land wherein ye are: for blood it defileth the land: and the land cannot be cleansed of the blood that is shed therein, but by the blood of him that shed it.
verses.am: ደም ምድሪቱን ያረክሳታልና የምትኖሩባትን ምድር አታርክሱአት፤ በደም አፍሳሹ ደም ካልሆነ በቀር ምድሪቱ ከፈሰሰባት ደም አትነጻም።

verses.en: Defile not therefore the land which ye shall inhabit, wherein I dwell: for I YAHUAH dwell among the children of Yisra'el.
verses.am: እኔ እግዚአብሔር በእስራኤል ልጆች መካከል አድራለሁና የምትኖሩባትን በመካከልዋም የማድርባትን ምድር አታርክሱአት።

verses.en: And the chief fathers of the families of the children of Gilead, the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh, of the families of the sons of Yoseph, came near, and spake before Mosheh, and before the princes, the chief fathers of the children of Yisra'el:
verses.am: ከዮሴፍ ልጆች ወገኖች የምናሴ ልጅ የማኪር ልጅ የገለዓድ ልጆች ወገን አለቆች ቀረቡ፥ በሙሴና በእስራኤልም ልጆች አባቶች አለቆች ፊት ተናገሩ፤

verses.en: And they said, YAHUAH commanded my lord to give the land for an inheritance by lot to the children of Yisra'el: and my lord was commanded by YAHUAH to give the inheritance of Zelophehad our brother unto his daughters.
verses.am: አሉም። ምድሪቱን ለእስራኤል ልጆች ርስት አድርገህ በዕጣ ከፍለህ ትሰጣቸው ዘንድ እግዚአብሔር አንተን ጌታችንን አዘዘህ፤ እግዚአብሔርም የወንድማችንን የሰለጰዓድን ርስት ለሴቶች ልጆቹ ትሰጥ ዘንድ አንተን ጌታችንን አዘዘ።

verses.en: And if they be married to any of the sons of the other tribes of the children of Yisra'el, then shall their inheritance be taken from the inheritance of our fathers, and shall be put to the inheritance of the tribe whereunto they are received: so shall it be taken from the lot of our inheritance.
verses.am: ከሌላም ከእስራኤል ልጆች ነገድ ባል ቢያገቡ፥ ርስታቸው ከአባቶቻችን ርስት ይነቀላል፥ እነርሱም ለሚሆኑበት ለሌላው ነገድ ርስት ይጨመራል፤ እንደዚህም የርስታችን ዕጣ ይጐድላል።

verses.en: And when the jubile of the children of Yisra'el shall be, then shall their inheritance be put unto the inheritance of the tribe whereunto they are received: so shall their inheritance be taken away from the inheritance of the tribe of our fathers.
verses.am: ለእስራኤልም ልጆች ኢዮቤልዩ በመጣ ጊዜ ርስታቸው ለሚሆኑበት ነገድ ርስት ይጨመራል፤ እንደዚህም ርስታቸው ከአባቶቻችን ነገድ ርስት ይጐድላል።

verses.en: And Mosheh commanded the children of Yisra'el according to the word of YAHUAH, saying, The tribe of the sons of Yoseph hath said well.
verses.am: ሙሴም የእስራኤልን ልጆች እንደ እግዚአብሔር ቃል እንዲህ ብሎ አዘዛቸው። የዮሴፍ ልጆች ነገድ በእውነት ተናገሩ።

verses.en: This is the thing which YAHUAH doth command concerning the daughters of Zelophehad, saying, Let them marry to whom they think best; only to the family of the tribe of their father shall they marry.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ስለ ሰለጰዓድ ሴቶች ልጆች ያዘዘው ነገር ይህ ነው፤ የወደዱትን ያግቡ፤ ነገር ግን ከአባታቸው ነገድ ብቻ ያግቡ።

verses.en: So shall not the inheritance of the children of Yisra'el remove from tribe to tribe: for every one of the children of Yisra'el shall keep himself to the inheritance of the tribe of his fathers.
verses.am: እንደዚህም የእስራኤል ልጆች ርስት ከነገድ ወደ ነገድ ምንም አይተላለፍ፤ ከእስራኤልም ልጆች እያንዳንዱ ወደ አባቶቹ ነገድ ርስት ይጠጋ።

verses.en: And every daughter, that possesseth an inheritance in any tribe of the children of Yisra'el, shall be wife unto one of the family of the tribe of her father, that the children of Yisra'el may enjoy every man the inheritance of his fathers.
verses.am: ከእስራኤልም ልጆች እያንዳንዱ ሰው የአባቶቹን ርስት ይወርስ ዘንድ፥ ከእስራኤል ልጆች ነገድ ሁሉ ርስት ያላት ሴት ልጅ ሁሉ ከአባትዋ ነገድ ባል ታግባ።

verses.en: Neither shall the inheritance remove from one tribe to another tribe; but every one of the tribes of the children of Yisra'el shall keep himself to his own inheritance.
verses.am: እንደዚህም ከአንድ ነገድ ወደ ሌላ ነገድ ምንም ርስት አይተላለፍ ከእስራኤልም ልጆች ነገድ እያንዳንዱ ወደ ርስቱ ይጠጋ።

verses.en: Even as YAHUAH commanded Mosheh, so did the daughters of Zelophehad:
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን እንዳዘዘው እንዲሁ የሰለጰዓድ ሴቶች ልጆች አደረጉ።

verses.en: For Mahlah, Tirzah, and Hoglah, and Milcah, and Noah, the daughters of Zelophehad, were married unto their father's brothers' sons:
verses.am: የሰለጰዓድ ልጆች ማህለህ፥ ቲርጻ፥ ዔግላ፥ ሚልካ፥ ኑዓ ከአባታቸው ወንድሞች ልጆች ጋር ተጋቡ።

verses.en: And they were married into the families of the sons of Manasseh the son of Yoseph, and their inheritance remained in the tribe of the family of their father.
verses.am: ከዮሴፍ ልጅ ከምናሴ ልጆች ወገኖች ባሎቻቸውን አገቡ፥ ርስታቸውም በአባታቸው ነገድ ጸና።

verses.en: These are the commandments and the judgments, which YAHUAH commanded by the hand of Mosheh unto the children of Yisra'el in the plains of Moab by Jordan near Jericho.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር በሙሴ እጅ የእስራኤልን ልጆች በዮርዳኖስ አጠገብ በኢያሪኮ አንጻር በሞዓብ ሜዳ ያዘዛቸው ትእዛዝና ፍርድ እነዚህ ናቸው።
